title: D2C Sales Closer (Remote, High-Ticket Education)
description: **Read This First** I've built a direct-to-consumer career-training business in the U.S. with one of the largest organic audiences in the space — 60 million+ organic views generating thousands of inbound inquiries every month, with no de minimus paid media budget. The funnel is built. The pipeline is full. The scripts, the follow-up sequences, and the CRM are all already in place. The offer is proven. Now I'm looking for a hard working, motivated professional to run it with me. This is a full time D2C sales role. You won't be one of fifty reps fighting for scraps — you'll own the entire D2C sales process I've built, with warm leads coming to you every day. This is not for “passengers”. I need a driver. You're not starting from zero and you're not cold-calling. The hard part — generating demand — is already done. Thousands of qualified people reach out to us every month. Your job is to connect with the ones we can genuinely help and guide them to a decision. If you want a quiet job to coast in, this is NOT it. If you're hungry, hardworking, and want to earn based on what you actually produce, keep reading. **About the Opportunity** We help hardworking U.S. adults launch new careers without years of school or heavy debt. You'll sell one program: Pharmacy Technician — a recognized credential, with a hands-on externship built into the program that connects students to real employer experience at pharmacies and hospitals. **Who You're Selling To** This is not an impulse purchase, and you can't sell it like one. Our customers are hardworking adults who already know they need new skills to get ahead. They want this. What stops them is fear — fear of spending money they've carefully budgeted on something that might not pay off. That fear is reasonable, and we respect it. Your job is to help the right people see clearly — to identify the ones who are a genuine fit and help them understand the return: what the credential is worth, what the externship gives them, and why the price is small compared to the career it opens up. it’s a Challenger sales model. **What You'll Do** - Run consultative sales calls — by phone or Zoom — with warm leads who already applied and booked themselves - Follow up with discipline. Most people don't enroll on the first call; career-education decisions usually take two to four conversations, so consistent follow-up is where the results come from - Own the pipeline. The scripts, sequences, and CRM are already built — but they're yours to run: texts, email s, notes, and follow-ups until you close or disqualify - Learn the program inside and out — the credential, the externship, the path to a job — so prospects trust you - Get coached by experienced sales leadership and improve the process as you run it **What I'm Looking For** - Experience selling higher education, online courses, or coaching programs — this is a longer, more consultative sale, and you need to understand that cycle - A real closing track record - Excellent spoken and written English — your calls and follow-ups must be clear and professional - A reliable home setup: fast internet, a quiet space, a good headset and webcam - Able to work U.S. time zones - Coachable, fast to apply feedback, no ego - Hungry, hardworking, resilient — you treat this like it's yours, because it will be **The Money** This is a commission-heavy role with uncapped earning. You're paid a flat commission for every enrollment you close and collect — the more you close, the more you earn, with no limit. Consistent closers earn excellent monthly income by local standards, and top performers earn well beyond that. We'll go through exact numbers on the call. **What to Expect** This is not an easy job, and warm leads don't change that. The people you talk to are interested, but most need follow-up and reassurance before they commit. If you need a lot of handholding or you fold under pressure, this won't be a fit. But if you're hungry, coachable, and you know how to sell, this is a rare chance to run a proven business as your own — and earn based entirely on what you produce. HOW TO APPLY SUBMIT APPLICATION BELOW ----------

title: Senior Sales Lead Generator
description: I am hiring a senior lead generator who can be located globally to generate qualified discovery calls with founder-led and CEO-led SMEs in Australia and globally for my AI consulting business. This is not a junior SDR role, not a generic appointment-setting role, and not a role for someone who needs hand-holding. You will be responsible for identifying good-fit businesses, doing outbound prospecting, opening commercial conversations, qualifying decision-makers properly, and booking attended discovery calls that I will run and close. If you need constant supervision, this is not the role. If you are good at getting senior decision-makers into quality sales conversations and you want upside without being micromanaged, keep reading. I will train you in how to use AI [I'm an expert in AI] and I will work with you to build AI automations to make your tasks more efficient and easier ## About the Business I help founder-led and CEO-led SMEs adopt AI in practical, commercially sound ways that improve performance, reduce risk, and strengthen execution without turning the business into a technology experiment. My work includes AI strategy, AI policy writing, AI training, readiness assessment, and implementation support for business owners and senior leaders who care about evidence, clarity, and execution discipline. I am not a software vendor, reseller, generic online course provider, or big-consulting-style advisory firm. The people I work best with are pragmatic leaders in services and professional services businesses who know AI matters but do not want hype, chaos, or random experimentation. ## What You Will Be Selling Into Your first job is to create qualified meetings for one flagship offer: AI Foundations Training at $5,000. This is a practical six-session online training programme delivered over two months for up to 10 participants, built around real work tasks rather than generic AI awareness content. It is a strong fit when a CEO can see AI matters, staff are already using ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot inconsistently, there is concern about poor usage or lack of structure, and leadership wants the team to use AI properly rather than casually. I position it as teaching your team AI skills so they can do more with less. ## Who You Will Target You will prospect into Australia and global markets and can be located globally. The ideal buyer is usually a founder, CEO, or managing director of a service-led SME with around 5 to 50 staff and roughly $1 million to $20 million in annual revenue. Strong-fit businesses are usually service and professional services firms rather than product companies, enterprise organisations, or startups building AI products. Poor-fit prospects include businesses looking only for software, generic AI awareness sessions, or technical build work rather than commercially grounded advisory and capability building. ## What You Will Actually Do - Build your own lead list using LinkedIn, email , networking, and public signals rather than waiting for me to hand you a pipeline. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Research companies and decision-makers properly before outreach. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Use trigger events and commercial context to decide who is worth contacting now. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Reach out to founders, CEOs, and managing directors with tailored messages that show you understand their likely AI situation. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI. - Start conversations around the right business problem, not generic “AI is the future” noise. - Qualify whether the prospect fits the ICP, has a real business problem, has some timing urgency, and is likely able to buy. - Book attended discovery calls with decision-makers and hand them over cleanly. - Record outreach, notes, status, and relevant context accurately inside my CRM. - Stay away from bad-fit leads that waste time, including enterprise firms, software shoppers, and people with no decision authority. ## What Good Looks Like You are not being measured on busywork, activity theatre, or whether you “look busy” online. You are being measured on outcomes. The main target is 12 attended qualified meetings per month with founder, CEO, or MD-level decision-makers who fit the ICP and are worth my time. A qualified meeting means the person attended, has decision-making authority, fits the business profile, and has enough budget, timing, and business pain to justify a serious discovery conversation. ## Must-Have Skills - Strong written English and commercially credible business communication. - Real experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting, or B2B meeting generation. - Confidence contacting senior decision-makers directly. - Good judgment about fit, timing, and whether a lead is worth pursuing. - Ability to personalise outreach using real business context instead of spraying templates. - Discipline to update CRM notes and handover information properly. - Comfort using LinkedIn, email , and basic AI support tools without relying on AI to think for you. - Enough maturity to work without fixed hours, daily chasing, or emotional neediness. ## Strong Advantage You will stand out if you have a understand how to prompt AI. You will stand out if you have sold or opened conversations into founder-led service businesses before. You will also stand out if you understand professional services buyers, know how to talk to owners without sounding like a script, and can spot public signals that show when AI training is timely. ## Who This Role Is For You are likely a fit if you are commercially sharp, self-directed, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning your own results. You do not need a manager standing over you. You do need to know how to create opportunity from cold or lightly warm conditions. You are probably not a fit if you want guaranteed pay for low-quality activity, struggle with rejection, or need a heavily structured employee environment. ## Working Style Can be located globally. Remote-first. Flexible working style. Results-driven. A mix of LinkedIn, email , and networking outreach, with judgment on what gets the result. Some tools may be provided, but I expect you to bring capability, not excuses. You must record outreach and notes in my CRM properly. You must not represent competing AI consulting offers while working with me. ## Commercial Terms The is base salary is $350 USD For the initial phase, commission is tied to AI Foundations Training only. You will earn $500 AUD per closed AI Foundations Training deal once the client’s first invoice has been paid. Our target is 4 closes per month [$2000 AUD comissions] Commission is payable on any AI Foundations deal from that account that closes within 30 days of the meeting booking date. Commission will be paid within 14 days of receipt of the client’s first invoice payment. If you prove you can consistently deliver good-fit opportunities for AI Foundations Training, I am open to negotiating commission arrangements for other services I offer later. ## First 60 Days The first review point is at 60 days. By then, I should be able to see whether you can source the right types of accounts, open credible conversations, book attended qualified meetings, and keep clean CRM records. If the meetings are weak, unqualified, or mostly no-shows, this will not work. If the meetings are good and the commercial logic is sound, there is room to build from there. ## How to Apply Send me the following: 1. A short introduction in clear English. 2. A brief summary of your experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting, or booking B2B meetings with senior decision-makers. 3. A short list of the channels and tools you have used, especially LinkedIn and email . 4. One example of a personalised outbound message you would send to the CEO of a professional services firm where staff are already using AI informally and leadership likely needs structure. 5. A short explanation of how you decide whether a lead is qualified before booking a meeting. 6. A short note on why role suits you.

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
job_title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description: Company Overview The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it. MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow. What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf. Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next. Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place. Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve. Position Overview: The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality. This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it. Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you. Key Responsibilities: Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development • Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others. • Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops. • Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity. • Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within. • Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands. • Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership. Operating Model Design & Service Delivery • Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities. • Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows. • Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice, email , chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores. • Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist. • Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement. • Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked. System Assessment & Service Technology Migration • Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation. • Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout. • Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base. • Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one. • Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head. • Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record. • Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist. Performance Management, Data & Reporting • Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team. • Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status. • Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed. • Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier. • Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas. Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance • Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner. • Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores. • Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards. • Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies. Qualifications: Required • 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change. • Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit. • Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice, email , chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it. • Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred. • Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it. • Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact. • Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership. • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership. • Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred. Nice-to-Have • Salesforce Service Cloud proficiency — case management, workflow rules, SLA configuration, omni-channel routing, and reporting. • Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing. • Workforce management platform experience (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar). • HIPAA familiarity and/or exposure to U.S. healthcare regulatory compliance operations. • Track record of building or rebuilding operations within a high-growth or category-defining company. • Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent contact center quality certification. job_title: Real Estate Cold Caller- Land and House Wholesaling
description: We are a real estate investment company that buys vacant land, lots, and residential properties directly from owners across the United States. We operate virtually and nationally. We are growing and looking for a driven, professional cold caller to join our team full time. ABOUT THE ROLE Your primary job is making outbound calls to property owners across the United States to identify motivated sellers who may be interested in a cash offer for their property. This is not a high pressure sales role. It is a relationship and qualification role. Your job is to have warm, genuine conversations, understand the seller's situation, gather property information, and identify whether there is a fit for our buying criteria. Full scripts, training, and all tools are provided. Real estate experience is a strong plus but we will train the right person. WHAT YOU WILL DO Make high volume outbound calls to property owners using our power dialer. Conduct warm, professional conversations based on provided scripts. Send immediate SMS follow up texts to contacts who did not answer or requested a callback. Qualify sellers by asking the right questions about their property and motivation. Log all call and text notes and activity in our CRM after every interaction. Identify and flag hot leads for immediate follow up by the acquisitions team. Manage follow up sequences combining calls and texts until a lead responds or is disqualified. Participate in brief weekly check-ins with the team. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required: Clear, confident, and warm phone voice. Reliable high speed internet connection. Quiet professional calling environment. Available Monday through Friday during US Eastern business hours. Strong written English for CRM note taking. Honest, dependable, and detail oriented. Takes initiative and does not wait to be told what to do. Flexible and adapts quickly when conversations take unexpected turns. Thinks on their feet and stays composed under pressure. Every seller is different and you need to meet them where they are. Strongly Preferred: Experience cold calling for US real estate investors or wholesalers. Familiarity with motivated seller outreach and land or house deals. Experience with CRM tools such as GoHighLevel, FreedomSoft, REsimpli, or similar. GoHighLevel experience is a strong plus as it is the platform we work in. English speakers are strongly encouraged to apply. Bilingual English and Spanish is an additional advantage but is not required. COMPENSATION AND HOURS $5 per hour Full time — 40 hours per week. Opportunity to increase pay based on performance and results. Long term role with growth potential as the company scales. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS This is a results-oriented role in a supportive environment. We invest in our team and want you to succeed. We also move fast and expect our callers to do the same. An experienced caller using our power dialer is expected to: Complete 300 to 500 dials per day. Have 50 to 100 live conversations per day. Send SMS follow ups to all unanswered contacts same day. Identify and log 3 to 8 qualified leads per day. Flag at least 1 HOT lead per day for immediate team follow up. If you have experience with power dialers and motivated seller calling you will recognize these as very achievable numbers. If high volume calling combined with a warm professional approach sounds like your strength, this role is built for you. If you prefer a slower pace this is not the right fit and that is completely okay. HOW TO APPLY To be considered please do both of the following. Applications missing either of these will not be reviewed. 1. Submit your resume or work history with relevant experience highlighted. 2. Answer these questions in writing: a. Describe a specific cold calling campaign you have worked on. What were you calling about, what was your approach, and what results did you get? b. Have you ever called motivated sellers for a real estate investor or wholesaling company? If yes, please describe the experience. c. Tell us about a time you had to think quickly and adapt during a difficult conversation. What happened and how did you handle it? We are not looking for someone to read a script robotically. We are looking for someone who is genuinely warm, professional, takes initiative, and takes pride in every conversation. Our sellers are real people going through real situations and we treat them with care and respect. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

This isn't a role for someone who leans on AI or templates to do the thinking for them. - Obsessive attention to detail: You check your own work and the work of others. title: Lead Generation Representative
description: JOB BRIEF As a Broker BDR, you will be the first point of contact for prospective freight broker accounts. Your primary focus is outbound prospecting — identifying brokers who would benefit from posting loads on 123Loadboard, generating interest, and qualifying opportunities before handing them off to a closing rep or advancing them yourself. You'll work a high-volume pipeline through cold calls, email sequences, and social outreach, and you'll be expected to deeply understand the broker's world: their load volume challenges, carrier sourcing pain points, and how our platform helps them move more freight with less friction. JOB DUTIES • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via cold calls, email , and LinkedIn to identify and engage freight brokers who are not yet active on 123Loadboard. • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined criteria (load volume, brokerage size, current load board usage) before passing to Account Executives. • Research target accounts using ZoomInfo, FMCSA data, and LinkedIn to build accurate contact lists of decision-makers at freight brokerages. • Conduct discovery calls to understand broker pain points around carrier sourcing, load coverage, and empty mile costs. • Schedule and coordinate product demonstrations or intro calls between qualified prospects and the broader sales team. • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all prospecting activity, lead status, and pipeline notes in Salesforce. • Participate in industry events, webinars, and trade shows (e.g., TIA) to source new leads and represent the 123Loadboard brand. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES • Meet or exceed monthly quotas for qualified opportunities created and meetings booked. • Build and maintain a healthy top-of-funnel pipeline that consistently feeds the Account Executive team. • Become fluent in 123Loadboard's value proposition for brokers — including competitive differentiation from DAT and Truckstop — to handle objections confidently. • Collaborate with marketing on messaging, campaigns, and target account lists to ensure outbound efforts are aligned with broader go-to-market strategy. • Provide feedback to sales leadership on common objections, market trends, and prospect sentiment to sharpen positioning and targeting. • Stay current on freight market conditions, brokerage industry news, and competitor activity. JOB REQUIREMENTS • 1–3 years of experience in an outbound sales, BDR, or SDR role — ideally in freight, logistics, or SaaS. • Familiarity with the freight brokerage industry — understanding of how brokers source carriers, manage load boards, and operate day-to-day is a strong asset. • Proven ability to hit outbound activity metrics (calls, email s, meetings booked) in a structured sales environment. • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM for pipeline tracking and activity logging. • Comfortable using prospecting tools such as ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar. • Strong communicator — able to quickly build rapport over the phone and craft compelling, concise outreach email s. • Coachable, competitive, and motivated by performance targets and clear career progression toward a closing role. • ---------- calls per day

You'll act as a trusted advisor — understanding the challenges owner-operators and small fleets face finding consistent loads and reducing empty miles — and demonstrate how 123Loadboard solves those problems. This role spans the full sales cycle from cold outreach to onboarding, with a focus on new account acquisition. description: Start your application with the word CLOSER at the very top. Applications without it will not be read. Who we are Building With Systems is a US-based recruiting agency that places door-to-door sales reps for roofing companies across the United States. We have 5 active clients and a high-volume pipeline. Our setter handles all the outreach and bookings. Your job is to close. What this role actually is You are the closer. Warm candidates come to you already booked onto a group intro call. You run the call, read the room, d ---------- who moves forward, conduct 1-on-1 interviews, and get qualified people sent to the client's office. But you're not just waiting for leads to be fed to you. When the pipeline is light — you hunt. You pick up the phone, you source your own candidates, you find your own appointments. You don't sit around. This is a sales role disguised as a recruiting role. If you've ever sold something to someone who wasn't sure they wanted it — you already have the core skill. What you'll be doing - Run 20-minute group intro calls on Zoom — camera on, professional setup, no exceptions - Read the room during every call — who's engaged, who's checked out, who's worth your time - Conduct 1-on-1 interviews within 48 hours of each group call - Use psychology and instinct to determine if a candidate has the grit for door-to-door sales - Make a hard decision at the end of every 1-on-1 — qualified, not qualified, or needs more info - Send qualified candidates to the client office and keep them warm until they walk in - Hunt independently when the pipeline needs it — LinkedIn, Indeed, direct outreach - Update GHL pipeline daily — every stage move logged before you close your laptop - Send a daily Slack update to leadership without being asked The camera requirement You will be on Zoom calls with American candidates every single day. Your camera must be on, your background must be clean and professional, your internet must be stable, and your audio must be clear. This is non-negotiable. If your setup isn't ready on day one, this isn't the right role for you right now. The money Base: $5/hr — full time, 40 hrs/week, Monday through Friday $50 per rep who stays with a client past 30 days $100 bonus in any month where more than 5 reps hit the 30-day mark A strong month where 8 reps hit 30 days = $400 in bonuses plus the $100 threshold bonus. description: JOB TITLE: Sales Trainer and Call Quality Analyst for U.S. Cold Calling Team JOB DESCRIPTION: InsureScales is looking for a full-time Sales Trainer and Call Quality Analyst to help train, coach, monitor, and improve our outbound cold calling team. InsureScales helps insurance agencies grow by providing trained outbound callers who handle cold calling, lead follow-up, appointment setting, and warm live transfers. Our callers speak with insurance agencies and prospects, follow scripts, qualify leads, update CRM records, and help generate new business opportunities. This is not a basic admin role. We need someone who understands cold calling, sales conversations, objection handling, call quality, compliance, appointment setting, and live transfer quality. Your main job will be to make our callers better every day. You will train new callers, listen to live calls, barge into calls when needed, review recorded calls, run QA meetings, coach reps one-on-one, and help improve the overall performance of the team. RESPONSIBILITIES: Train new callers on cold calling, sales basics, scripts, call flow, objection handling, appointment setting, and live transfers. Coach callers on how to open calls, control conversations, ask better questions, overcome objections, and book better appointments. Teach callers how to sound confident, natural, professional, and clear on the phone. Listen to live calls through the dialer. Barge into calls, whisper coach, or assist live when needed. Review recorded calls and score them using a QA scorecard. Run daily or weekly QA meetings with callers. Conduct one-on-one performance reviews with reps. Identify common mistakes across the team and create training to fix them. Make sure callers follow the approved script, call flow, objection responses, and qualification standards. Monitor compliance, including DNC requests, opt-out handling, call recording rules, accurate representations, and proper CRM dispositions. Make sure callers do not make false promises, misleading statements, or unapproved claims. Review CRM notes, call dispositions, appointment quality, and live transfer quality. Track caller performance trends such as call volume, conversations, appointments, transfers, show rate, call quality, script adherence, and compliance issues. Create performance improvement plans for callers who are struggling. Give clear feedback to management on which callers are improving, which callers need help, and which callers may not be a fit. Help improve scripts, rebuttals, training materials, roleplay exercises, QA scorecards, and call review processes. REQUIREMENTS: You must have previous experience training cold callers, appointment setters, telemarketers, outbound sales reps, or call center agents. You must understand outbound cold calling and phone sales. You must have experience listening to calls and giving direct coaching feedback. You must have experience with QA scorecards, call reviews, call monitoring, or sales coaching. You must have excellent spoken and written English. You must be able to identify why a call went well or poorly. You must be able to coach tone, pacing, confidence, script control, questioning, objection handling, qualification, and closing. You must be comfortable giving direct feedback without being rude or discouraging. You must be detail-oriented and able to hold reps accountable. You must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, and quiet workspace. You must be available to work U.S. Eastern Time hours. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience training B2B appointment setters is a strong plus. Experience in insurance, lead generation, SaaS, real estate, financial services, or telemarketing is a plus. Experience using dialers with live monitoring, whisper, barge, or call takeover features is a plus. Experience building training materials, QA forms, call scorecards, or onboarding programs is a plus. Experience managing Filipino outbound callers is a plus. Experience improving appointment quality, live transfer quality, and show rates is a plus. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF: Do not apply if you have never trained or coached callers before. Do not apply if you only have customer service experience and no outbound sales or cold calling experience. Do not apply if you are afraid to give direct feedback. Do not apply if you cannot work U.S. Eastern Time hours. Do not apply if you do not like listening to calls carefully. Do not apply if you are not detail-oriented. Do not apply if you cannot hold reps accountable. Do not apply if you only want an easy admin job. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: Callers become more confident, natural, and effective on the phone. Callers follow the script and process more consistently. Appointment quality improves. Live transfer quality improves. Compliance mistakes decrease. CRM notes and dispositions become cleaner. Weak reps receive clear coaching and improvement plans. Strong reps continue getting better. The entire calling team becomes more disciplined, accountable, and productive. WORK SCHEDULE: Full-time position. Monday to Friday. Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time calling hours so you can monitor live calls and coach the team in real time. Exact shift will be discussed during the interview. PAY: Competitive monthly salary based on experience. Please include your expected monthly salary in USD when applying. HOW TO APPLY: Please send the following when applying: Your resume. A short summary of your experience training or coaching outbound callers. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit for this role. Your expected monthly salary in USD. Your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time. A list of dialers, CRMs, or call monitoring tools you have used. Answers to the following questions: How many years of experience do you have training or QA’ing outbound callers? What type of campaigns have you trained callers for? What are the top 3 things you listen for when reviewing a cold call? How would you coach a caller who sounds robotic and just reads the script? How would you handle a caller who books unqualified appointments just to hit a number? Have you ever used live call monitoring, whisper, or barge features before? Use this exact subject line when applying: QA TRAINER - INSURESCALES Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Operations Manager — Recruitment & Lead Gen (Remote, Full-Time)
job_title: Operations Manager — Recruitment & Lead Gen (Remote, Full-Time)
description: Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation) Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role. Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows. About the role and how we work together: I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it. The most important quality, above everything else: You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro ---------- , a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for. What you will actually be doing, day to day: On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below. On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential. Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast. Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm. The kind of person who thrives here: Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them. Skills to have already : Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days. Compensation: $500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management. To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test: 1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did? 2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them? 3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly. 4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable. 5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do? 6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly. 7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

job_title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for U.S. Local Businesses
description: # B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for U.S. Local Businesses ## Job Overview We are hiring a B2B cold caller / appointment setter to call local businesses in the United States and book qualified appointments with business owners. We work with plumbing and home service businesses. Our service helps these businesses capture missed and after-hours calls so they can book more jobs instead of losing leads to voi cemail or slow follow-up. Your job is to call business owners, ask simple qualification questions, and book appointments for our closer. You are not responsible for closing the sale. Your job is to set quality appointments with interested business owners. ## Compensation This role includes guaranteed hourly pay plus performance bonuses. Paid trial: **$3 USD per hour for the first 10 hours** After successful trial: **$4 USD per hour** Performance bonuses: **$12.5 USD for every qualified appointment that shows up** **$50 USD for every appointment that becomes a closed, paid client** A closed, paid client means the business owner attends the appointment, signs the agreement, and pays the first invoice. Bonuses are paid after the appointment shows or after the client’s first payment is received. ## Daily Call Expectations Expected ramp-up: **Training period:** 75–100 dials per day **Week 1:** 100–150 dials per day **Week 2:** 150–200 dials per day **Experienced target:** 200–300 dials per day depending on shift length and call quality All calls must be made through our CRM/calling system so activity can be tracked. Calls made outside the CRM will not count. ## Main Performance Goal The main goal is to book qualified appointments with business owners. A realistic target is: **3–5 qualified appointments per week once fully trained** Quality matters more than fake volume. We do not want random appointments with people who are not decision makers. ## What Counts as a Qualified Appointment An appointment counts as qualified only if: * You spoke with the owner or decision maker * The business is a plumbing company or relevant home service business * The owner is interested in missed-call or after-hours call capture * The owner understands why the meeting is being booked * The appointment is added to the calendar * The owner receives a confirmation message * CRM notes are fully completed * The prospect is not fake, spam, or unable to make decisions A random “call me later” does not count as a qualified appointment. ## Responsibilities You will be responsible for: * Making outbound calls to U.S. local businesses * Asking for the owner or decision maker * Following the provided script * Asking about missed calls, after-hours calls, voi cemail , and answering services * Finding out if the business has a problem with missed calls or slow follow-up * Booking qualified appointments on the calendar * Sending appointment confirmation messages * Taking clear notes in the CRM * Updating lead status after every call * Creating follow-up tasks for interested prospects * Sending a daily activity report ## Example Call Script You will be trained on a script like this: “Hey, is this {{Business Name}}?” “Awesome, is the owner around?” When speaking with the owner: “Hey {{Owner Name}}, this is {{Your Name}}. Quick question — when someone calls after-hours for an emergency plumbing job, does that go to a live person, voi cemail , or an answering service?” If they answer: “Got it. The reason I’m calling is we help plumbing companies capture missed and after-hours calls so they can turn more of those calls into booked jobs instead of losing them to voi cemail . Would it be crazy to have Maxx take 15 minutes to show you how it works?” If they already use an answering service: “That makes sense. Are they actually booking jobs into your calendar, or mostly just taking messages?” If interested: “Perfect. Maxx can show you how the missed-call revenue system works. Does tomorrow at {{time}} or {{time}} work better?” ## Required CRM Notes For every real conversation, you must enter notes in the CRM. Notes must include: * Business name * Owner or decision maker name * Phone number * Current call handling process * Whether they miss calls * What happens after-hours * Whether they use voi cemail , office staff, or answering service * Pain points mentioned * Interest level * Appointment date and time * Confirmation status * Objections or special notes If there are no notes, the appointment may not count. ## Required Skills You must have: * Strong spoken English * Confident phone voice * Cold calling experience * Ability to handle rejection * Ability to follow a script * Good note-taking skills * Reliable internet * Quiet work environment * Headset or clear microphone * Ability to work during U.S. business hours * Fast response time * Strong work ethic * Ability to make consistent outbound calls ## Preferred Experience Preferred but not required: * B2B cold calling experience * Appointment setting experience * Experience calling local businesses * Experience with GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRMs * Experience selling marketing, software, lead generation, or appointment setting services * Experience calling home service businesses ## Work Schedule You must be available to call during U.S. business hours. Preferred calling windows: Monday through Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. time zones You may be calling businesses in Eastern, Central, Mountain, and Pacific time zones. ## Tracking and Accountability All calls must be tracked inside our CRM. We track: * Dials * Conversations * Decision makers reached * Follow-ups created * Qualified appointments booked * Appointments confirmed * Appointments that show * Closed clients If calls are not logged in the CRM, they do not count. ## Daily Report At the end of each workday, you must send a daily report with: * Total dials * Total conversations * Decision makers reached * Follow-ups created * Appointments booked * Appointments confirmed * Best lead notes * Main objections heard * Any issues or questions ## Application Instructions To apply, please send: 1. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself 2. Your cold calling experience 3. Your appointment setting experience 4. Your available work schedule in U.S. time zones 5. Your internet speed screenshot 6. Your headset/microphone setup 7. The most outbound calls you have made in one day 8. A short answer to this question: “What would you say if a plumbing business owner says, ‘We already have someone answering calls’?” ## Test Script Please record yourself saying this: “Hey, is this {{Business Name}}? Awesome, is the owner around?” Then: “Hey {{Owner Name}}, this is {{Your Name}}. Quick question — when someone calls after-hours for an emergency plumbing job, does that go to a live person, voi cemail , or an answering service?” ## Final Note We are looking for someone reliable, coachable, and consistent. This role includes hourly pay and performance bonuses. If you can make calls, follow the script, book quality appointments, and keep accurate CRM notes, there is a strong opportunity to grow with us.

description: Type: Full-time or Part-time (start ~30 hrs/week, can grow) Schedule: US business/evening hours — this is a night shift in PH time Pay: Competitive base (USD) + uncapped per-appointment and per-deal bonuses Location: Remote (Philippines), work-from-home Read this whole post carefully — we only want the top 1% of callers, and the application instructions at the bottom will filter out everyone who didn't. We're a US real estate acquisitions company that buys houses for cash nationwide. We run high-volume outbound calling every day, and the phone is what d ---------- whether our closers get fed or the pipeline goes dry. We're not looking for someone to just "make dials." We're looking for a phone operator who understands that the cold caller is the closer's most important teammate. Our closers have done over half a billion dollars in sales over the phone. Your job is to put motivated home sellers in front of them. We measure everything. Callers who book appointments that show up and close get more leads, better lists, and more money. Callers who just ring dead air and clock out get cut. The setters we love treat every conversation like a live deal and every objection like a door, not a wall. THE ROLE You'll own the top of the funnel for our acquisitions team — calling skip-traced seller data, getting homeowners talking, uncovering real motivation, and locking qualified appointments our closers can turn into contracts. Three pillars to this role: 1. Conversations. You can stay sharp on call 300 like you were on call 3. Rejection doesn't rattle you, volume doesn't burn you out, and you genuinely enjoy talking to strangers — because you're good at it. 2. Discovery & rapport. Anyone can read a script. You get sellers to actually open up — why they're really selling, the situation behind it, the timeline, the number in their head. You listen more than you talk and you hear what they're not saying. 3. Setting. You don't just "generate interest" — you lock the appointment. You qualify hard (motivation, equity, timeline, condition), handle the objection before it lands, and set appointments that actually show up and close. A no-show is a loss, and you know it. The callers who win can do all three: grind the dials, build trust fast, and close for the next step. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING - Running a power dialer through skip-traced seller lists — measured on contacts and appointments set, not vanity dial counts - Holding real conversations with US homeowners and uncovering motivation, timeline, condition, and price expectations - Qualifying leads against our buy box — knowing a real motivated seller from a tire-kicker - Setting qualified appointments directly onto our closers' calendars - Handling objections and gatekeepers calmly ("I'm not interested," "what's your offer," "how'd you get my number") - Logging every single call accurately in the CRM — if it's not logged right, it didn't happen - Working callbacks fast — a seller who calls back is the hottest lead you'll get - Hitting daily targets across set call windows (we manage to dials/hr, contacts/hr, and appointments set) - Communicating with the team on Slack about what's landing and what's not WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Phone skills: - 2+ years of high-volume outbound — US real estate acquisitions/wholesaling strongly preferred, or hard B2C cold calling that actually converted - Rejection-proof and high-energy through a full shift — call 300 sounds like call 3 - Excellent, clear, easy-to-understand spoken English — you're talking to US homeowners all day and they need to trust you instantly - You sound like a human having a conversation, not someone reading a script Sales & discovery: - You build rapport in the first 15 seconds and get past the wall - Real objection-handling — a calm, practiced answer to every common "no," and you know a real objection from a brush-off - description: This is not a standard VA role. If you have hands-on experience posting jobs on Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, Craigslist, or similar US job boards — and you understand how to get listings live, indexed, and driving real applicant volume — read every word below. The core engine is driving job applicants through multiple ATS platforms and job boards into a conversion funnel. Revenue is performance-based — volume and consistency directly determine income, for the business and for you through bonuses. This is not a slow corporate job. Things move fast, methods change, platforms shift. I need someone who thrives in that environment — not someone who needs a fixed manual to follow every day. WHAT YOUR CORE JOB IS Job board posting is your primary function and your specialty. Specifically: — Post jobs daily at volume across Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, Craigslist, state job boards, and any other US platform you know or discover. — Understand how to get listings properly indexed and visible — not just posted. — Manage multiple posting accounts across platforms cleanly without mixing anything up. — Know which job categories, titles, and descriptions drive the most applicant volume — and apply that knowledge. — Track daily results, report what is working, and suggest improvements without being asked. — Proactively find new job boards, new posting angles, and new traffic sources on your own initiative. THE MOST IMPORTANT QUALITY You learn fast and work independently. I explain something once. You figure out the rest. When something breaks you try five approaches before you come to me. This quality matters more than any specific skill you already have. THE KIND OF PERSON WHO THRIVES HERE — You genuinely enjoy repetitive, manual, high-volume work — the grind does not exhaust you. — You are emotionally steady — demo calls involve pressure, new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm through both. — You take full ownership. If something is your responsibility and it is not done, you feel it personally. — You are organized and write everything down — processes, results, what worked, what did not. — You are honest. This is a high-trust role with real access and real responsibility. — You want to grow — from executor into someone who runs a team. SKILLS Must have — Hands-on experience posting jobs on US platforms — Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, Craigslist, or similar. This is non-negotiable as your core function. — Understanding of how job listings get indexed and drive applicant volume — not just how to submit a form. — Experience managing multiple accounts on any platform cleanly. — Comfort with or fast willingness to learn proxies, incognito browsing, and US phone number sourcing. Strong bonus: — Experience with ATS platforms like Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS. — Experience on software demo or sales calls. — LinkedIn Recruiter or LinkedIn job slot experience. — Any background in lead generation, performance marketing, or recruitment operations. COMPENSATION — Base: $500 – $800 per month depending on experience — Performance bonus tied directly to applicant volume and results — Hours: Full-time, 10–12 hours per day in early phase — Timezone: Indian afternoon and night hours for US overlap — Growth path: Specialist ? Operations Manager as team grows TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL 7 QUESTIONS. SKIP ANY QUESTION = APPLICATION IGNORED. THIS INSTRUCTION IS ITSELF PART OF THE TEST. 1. Tell me specifically which job boards you have posted on, how many listings you managed at once, and what results you saw in terms of applicant volume. Be specific — platform names, numbers, timeframes. 2. How do you make sure a job listing actually gets seen and indexed properly — not just submitted? What do you know about this? 3. Tell me about something complex you taught yourself using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you get good at it and how do you know? 4. Have you ever managed multiple accounts on any platform simultaneously — keeping them clean and separate? Describe exactly how you did it. 5. Have you ever researched a company and joined a demo or sales call to set up a software account? Describe it honestly. 6. Describe a time something kept failing and you tried multiple approaches until it worked. What happened? 7. Are you available full-time, 10–12 hours per day, working Indian afternoon and night hours for US timezone overlap?

title: Sales Manager
description: Sales Operations Manager / AI Sales Performance Manager About Cynergists Cynergists provides advanced AI Agents designed to help businesses automate workflows, increase productivity, and unlock scalable growth. We do not just fill seats. We deploy intelligent operations. We are building the future of AI-powered business growth through agentic CRM systems, AI Workforce Agents, sales automation, lead generation, and intelligent follow-up systems. Our mission is to help small and mid-sized businesses scale like giants without needing bloated internal teams. The Role We are looking for a highly organized, assertive, and tech-curious Sales Operations Manager to help lead and manage our growing sales team. This is not a traditional sales manager role where you are expected to personally close every deal. Your main responsibility is to make sure the sales team is executing every day, following the process, using the CRM correctly, improving from AI-generated feedback, and moving opportunities through the pipeline. You will work directly inside the Cynergists CRM and with our AI Sales Trainer to monitor sales activity, review call performance, track follow-ups, identify stuck deals, and help each sales representative improve. The right person is calm under pressure, strong with details, comfortable holding people accountable, and excited about using AI to improve sales performance. Our uploaded sales role template emphasizes diagnostic selling, pipeline management, AI sales training, CRM usage, and market feedback as core responsibilities for Cynergists sales positions . This manager role builds on that foundation but focuses on leading the team and making sure the sales system runs properly. Key Responsibilities Sales Team Accountability Manage daily sales activity across the team, including calls, texts, email s, booked appointments, follow-ups, and pipeline movement. Ensure every sales representative is following the required sales process, completing assigned outreach, updating the CRM, and staying on top of their opportunities. Run daily or weekly check-ins with sales reps to review activity, performance, challenges, and next steps. Hold reps accountable when activity drops, follow-ups are missed, or pipeline records are incomplete. CRM and Pipeline Management Monitor the Cynergists CRM to ensure leads, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, and deal stages are updated correctly. Identify stale opportunities, missing follow-ups, incomplete contact records, and deals with no next step. Make sure every active prospect has a clear next action assigned. Track the full pipeline from first conversation to booked appointment, proposal, close, or lost deal. AI Sales Coaching and Performance Review Use Cynergists’ AI Sales Trainer and call scoring tools to review sales rep performance. Monitor call scores, conversation quality, objection handling, buyer sentiment, follow-up quality, and close attempts. Help sales reps understand their AI-generated feedback and turn it into better sales behavior. Identify patterns across the team, including weak openers, poor discovery, missed closes, pricing objections, or lack of urgency. Sales Reporting Prepare weekly sales performance reports for leadership. Track key sales metrics, including: Calls made Conversations started Appointments booked Show rate Follow-up completion Pipeline created Deals closed Close rate Average call score Rep-by-rep performance trends Flag underperforming reps and recommend corrective action. Sales Process Improvement Help improve scripts, sales workflows, CRM automations, objection handling, and follow-up sequences. Listen to feedback from business owners and sales reps to identify gaps in our offers, sales materials, or AI Agent catalog. Relay market feedback to leadership and the development team so Cynergists can improve its products and sales process. Training and Onboarding Assist with onboarding new sales representatives. Teach reps how to use the CRM, follow the sales process, review AI feedback, and manage their pipeline. Help create simple SOPs, checklists, and training materials for the sales team. Run roleplays and objection-handling practice when needed. What We Are Looking For Strong Accountability You must be comfortable holding sales reps accountable. This role is not just admin support. You need to be able to say, “This was not completed,” “This follow-up was missed,” or “Your call score dropped and we need to fix it.” Sales or Appointment Setting Experience You do not need to be a world-class closer, but you should understand sales activity, follow-up, objections, CRM pipelines, and appointment setting. Experience managing or supporting outbound sales teams is a major plus. CRM Experience Experience with Go High Level, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, Pipedrive, or another CRM is preferred. You must be comfortable learning software quickly and working inside dashboards every day. Tech-Savvy Mindset You do not need to be a developer, but you must be excited about AI, automation, and software. You should be comfortable using AI tools to review performance, summarize activity, identify problems, and improve sales execution. Organized and Detail-Oriented You must be able to manage multiple reps, tasks, follow-ups, reports, and deadlines without letting things fall through the cracks. Clear Communication Strong written and verbal English communication is required. You will communicate with sales reps, leadership, and occasionally other departments, so clarity matters. Calm Under Pressure Sales teams move fast. Leads get missed. Reps get frustrated. Deals stall. We need someone who stays calm, solves problems, and keeps the team moving. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing appointment setters, sales reps, or virtual sales teams Experience working remotely Experience with Go High Level Experience with AI tools or sales automation Experience reviewing call recordings or sales performance Experience creating SOPs or training materials Experience working with U.S.-based companies Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills Performance Expectations Success in this role will be measured by: Sales reps completing required daily activity CRM records staying clean and updated Follow-ups being completed on time Pipeline stages being accurate Improvement in rep call scores Increase in appointments booked Increase in close rate Reduction in missed leads and stalled deals Clear weekly reporting to leadership Why Join Cynergists? Work in the Future of AI Sales You will be helping build and manage an AI-powered sales organization, not an outdated manual sales team. Real Leadership Opportunity As Cynergists grows, this role can become a larger leadership position managing more reps, more processes, and more revenue operations. Remote Work This is a remote position. You can work from your own space while supporting a fast-growing U.S.-based AI company. AI-Powered Training and Support You will have access to our AI Sales Trainer, CRM tools, call scoring, and internal systems to help you manage the team effectively. Growth-Oriented Culture We are building fast. The right person will have room to grow with the company. Schedule Full-time preferred. Must be available during core U.S. business hours for sales team check-ins, reporting, and leadership communication. Compensation Competitive monthly compensation based on experience. Performance bonuses may be available based on team sales activity, booked appointments, closed revenue, and CRM compliance. To Apply Submit your resume and a short cover letter explaining: Why you would be a strong fit to manage a sales team Your experience with CRM systems or sales operations Your experience holding people accountable Why you are interested in AI-powered sales

title: Heir Outreach Specialist
description: We are hiring a confident, persuasive, and highly proactive Heir Outreach Specialist to help our real estate investment company contact property owners and heirs connected to distressed Florida properties. This is not a passive admin role. This role is for someone who enjoys starting conversations, moving people to action, asking direct questions, and staying calm when a family situation is complicated. Our business solves title problems involving inherited property, probate issues, tax deed risk, liens, judgments, and family ownership problems. Your job is to help us reach the right heirs, confirm family relationships, gather key facts, build trust quickly, and keep communication moving so our acquisitions and transaction teams can close deals. What You Will Do • Call, text, and follow up with heirs and property owners connected to inherited or distressed Florida real estate. • Start conversations confidently with people who may not be expecting your call. • Identify decision-makers inside families with multiple heirs, siblings, children, spouses, or extended relatives. • Ask clear fact-finding questions about family relationships, deceased owners, probate status, property history, occupancy, and seller motivation. • Build rapport quickly while still keeping the conversation focused and productive. • Overcome hesitation and confusion without being pushy, rude, or robotic. • Document every conversation accurately inside our CRM so the rest of the team knows exactly what happened and what needs to happen next. • Coordinate warm handoffs to the acquisitions team when a seller or heir is ready to discuss an offer. • Persistently follow up until the family situation is understood, the right person is reached, or the lead is properly disqualified. Who This Role Is Perfect For • You are naturally confident on the phone and do not freeze when someone is guarded, confused, emotional, or skeptical. • You like winning conversations, solving people puzzles, and figuring out who has authority inside a family. • You are comfortable being direct, but you know how to sound respectful and human. • You move fast, follow up aggressively, and do not need to be reminded five times to complete the next step. • You prefer clear goals, measurable results, and real responsibility over repetitive low-impact admin work. • You can handle messy information, incomplete family trees, and leads where the first person you reach is not the final decision-maker. • You are energized by the challenge of turning cold or lukewarm contacts into productive conversations. You Will Not Be a Fit If • You are uncomfortable making outbound calls or speaking with strangers. • You need every step scripted before you can take action. • You avoid difficult conversations or give up after one unanswered call. • You are careless with notes, names, dates, phone numbers, or relationship details. • You sound overly timid, overly formal, or robotic on the phone. • You prefer back-office data entry and do not want to be accountable for outreach results. Required Skills • Strong spoken English with a clear, confident, professional phone presence. • Experience with outbound calling, sales, appointment setting, customer service, collections, real estate, legal intake, probate, or lead follow-up is strongly preferred. • Ability to ask questions, listen carefully, and control the direction of a conversation. • Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, and phone software. • Fast and accurate note-taking after calls and text conversations. • Stable internet connection, quiet work environment, and reliable computer. • High ownership: you follow through without needing constant supervision. Real Estate / Probate Experience You do not need to be an expert in Florida probate or curative title work before starting. We will train the right person on our lead types, terminology, workflows, and CRM process. However, you must be a fast learner, comfortable with complex family situations, and willing to study the business so you can improve quickly. Performance Expectations • Make consistent outbound calls, texts, and follow-ups during assigned work hours. • Reach heirs, confirm relationships, and identify the right decision-makers. • Maintain clean CRM records after every meaningful interaction. • Move qualified leads forward quickly instead of letting them sit idle. • Communicate daily progress, blockers, and next-step recommendations to the team. • Demonstrate measurable improvement in call quality, contact rate, lead qualification, and handoffs over time. Training and Support • Call scripts, talk tracks, and objection-handling guidance. • Training on inherited property, heirs, probate-related terminology, and title problems. • CRM workflow training and lead status definitions. • Daily or weekly coaching based on actual calls, notes, and results. • Clear success metrics so you always know what winning looks like. Work Schedule This role requires availability during U.S. calling hours. Exact schedule can be discussed, but strong candidates should be available for meaningful overlap with Central Time business hours. Consistent attendance, responsiveness, and daily execution are required. Compensation $5/hr + $250 bonus per deal closed How to Apply To apply, send an email to ---------- with the subject line: “Heir Outreach - I Can Move Leads Forward” • A short summary of your outbound calling, sales, real estate, legal, probate, collections, or lead follow-up experience. • A 60- to 90-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be effective in this role. • Your available work hours in Central Time. • DISC test results: ---------- • A brief answer to this question: “Tell me about a time you had to keep following up with someone who was hard to reach. What did you do?” Applications without a voice recording, specified DISC test results, and the required subject line may not be reviewed.

Agent: Hi Jane, this is Mary with Bizwai. I'll be very brief—we work with small business owners, including contractors, to clean up bookkeeping, improve cash flow visibility, and show which jobs are actually making money. Did I catch you at a terrible time? If they ask what this is about: "Totally fair. We're reaching out to smaller contractors in Los Angeles because a lot of owners are good at the trade, but the numbers are usually behind—invoices, receipts, payroll, job costs, taxes, and cash flow all get mixed together. We're offering a free financial clarity review to see if anything is leaking profit or creating tax surprises." Question 1: "Are you currently using QuickBooks, or are you tracking things another way?" Question 2: "Do you usually know after each job whether it actually made the margin you expected?" Question 3: "Is collecting payments and keeping cash flow steady ever an issue, or are you pretty comfortable with that?" If they show any pain: "That's exactly where we help. We're not just a bookkeeper entering transactions. We help organize the numbers so you can see cash flow, job profit, unpaid invoices, expenses, and taxes before they become a problem."
