description: About Barnes Nest Barnes Nest is a U.S.-based online marketplace for home services. Our mission is to make hiring a trusted local contractor simple, safe, and fair — for both sides. Homeowners post a project, compare quotes from verified local pros, and pay securely through escrow (the money is only released when the work is approved). Contractors and handymen get real local jobs with NO lead fees — they only pay a small percentage on jobs they actually complete. We're launching in one U.S. metro and need help filling the platform with real users. The Role You'll be our growth/lead-generation specialist. Your #1 job: turn local contractors AND homeowners into active users on our platform. This is outreach + list-building + light social media — not just data entry. You'll be the engine that gets our first hundreds of users signed up. What you'll do Build targeted lists of local contractors (plumbers, HVAC, handymen, electricians, etc.) and their public contact info from directories, Google Maps, license registries, and social media. Reach out to contractors via email , Facebook , Instagram, and other channels using our proven scripts — explaining the "no lead fees + guaranteed payment" pitch and inviting them to create a free profile. Follow up persistently and politely; track every lead's status in a spreadsheet/CRM (Not contacted ? Messaged ? Replied ? Signed up). Help contractors complete their profile so they actually get matched (walk them through it via chat/email). Find and engage homeowner communities (Facebook groups, Nextdoor, local forums) to drive people to post jobs on the platform. Manage and grow our social media (Facebook , Instagram, Pinterest) — schedule posts, reply to comments/DMs, and engage local audiences (we provide the post templates). Report your numbers weekly: outreach sent, replies, sign-ups, profiles completed. What we're looking for Excellent written English — your messages must sound natural, friendly, and professional. Experience in lead generation, sales outreach, appointment setting, or social media management. Self-starter who is organized, persistent, and comfortable being told "no" and following up. Comfortable with spreadsheets/CRMs, Google Workspace, and social media tools. Reliable internet and able to work during some U.S. business hours. Nice to have Experience with U.S. clients, home-services / contractors, or marketplace/startup growth. Basic Canva / graphic skills for social posts. Familiarity with tools like Apollo, Hunter, or similar list-building tools. What we provide Proven outreach scripts, a recruitment flyer, target lead lists, and social post templates. Clear training on our mission and the platform. A real chance to grow with us as we scale to more cities. Compensation Hourly pay PLUS a bonus for every contractor or homeowner you successfully onboard (active, complete profile). Top performers can move to full-time with higher pay. How to apply Start your message with the word "NEST" so I know you read this post. Tell me briefly about your lead-generation or outreach experience (and any results — e.g., sign-ups or appointments you've booked). Include a short sample of an outreach message YOU would send to a local plumber to convince them to join a marketplace with no lead fees. List the tools you've used for lead gen or social media. Applications without the word "NEST" and a writing sample will not be considered.

Reopening the conversation, handling objections (price, hesitation, "just looking", "I'll do it later"), and getting them to complete the purchase 3. Following up by call, SMS or email where needed 4. Logging every call outcome accurately so we can track what's working 5. Hitting daily call volume and weekly recovery targets What success looks like: You'll be measured on three things- 1. Dials and contacts per day (your activity) 2. Contact-to-recovery conversion rate (your skill) 3. Total carts recovered per week (the outcome that earns your bonus) I'll give you clear targets in week one and review your numbers with you weekly. Proven outbound phone experience: telesales, appointment setting, cold calling, collections, or BPO outbound campaigns. Tell me exactly what you did. 2. Availability during Australian hours, roughly 10am to 8pm AEST (about 8am to 6pm Philippine time), since our customers are in Australia 5. Reliable high speed internet, a good quality headset, and a quiet place to call from 6. Reliability and honest reporting. I track outcomes, so there is nowhere to hide a slow day, and I reward consistency. Nice-to-haves (not necessary but will help you stand out): 1. Experience with WooCommerce, which is the platform we use day to day 2. Experience in DTC ecommerce or with consumer products 3. Experience selling to Australian or other Western customers 4. Familiarity with diallers, SMS tools, or CRMs in general 5. Experience working to a commission or bonus structure before About the product (so you can self-select): We sell nicotine products to adult customers in Australia. Starting rate: USD $6 per hour, paid for every hour you work from day one. This is your guaranteed base and it does not go away. 2. The first two weeks are a paid probation on this flat hourly rate while we assess how you perform. 3. After you pass probation, you keep the hourly base and move onto a performance bonus for every cart you recover. This is where the real money is. description: Read this fully. This is a long-term role with a real, growing U.S. company, not a one-off gig. We are an established U.S.-based M&A advisory and business brokerage firm headquartered in Utah. We guide business owners through three stages: Value (a certified valuation so they know what their company is worth), Scale (growing the business to maximize its future worth), and Exit (selling when they're ready). Many of these owners spent 20 or 30 years building their companies. The conversations you'll start are meaningful, and we treat them, and you, with that level of respect. We're hiring an Appointment Setter and outbound Sales Development Rep to be the friendly, professional first voice an owner hears from our firm. You are not reading a script at people. You're starting real conversations, listening for where an owner is in their journey, and booking qualified meetings with our advisors. This is a trust-based role, and we'll train you on the M&A side so you can grow with us. What you'll actually do: -Build and clean targeted lead lists of U.S. business owners by industry, location, revenue, and ownership signals (LinkedIn, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Google, public directories). -Make warm and cold outbound calls, email s, and follow-ups to owners who may want to value, scale, or exit. -Have short, genuine qualifying conversations: what's the business, how big, what's their timeline, and which stage are they in. -Book confirmed appointments for our advisors and protect their calendars from no-shows with smart reminders. -Keep the CRM (HubSpot) spotless: every contact, note, and next step logged. -Send a simple weekly report: dials, conversations, appointments set, and appointments held. What success looks like Weeks 1 to 2: you learn our offer, our talk tracks, and our ideal owner, and you start dialing with support. By day 30: you're holding quality conversations on your own and booking your first qualified meetings. By day 90: you're consistently filling the advisors' calendars with qualified appointments each week, with a strong show rate and a clean pipeline. You'll be great here if you Have 5+ years of cold calling, appointment setting, or B2B sales development experience. Speak clear, confident, neutral-accent English. You'll be live with U.S. business owners every day. Write professional, friendly English for follow-ups. Stay warm and steady through rejection, and keep going. Are organized and CRM-disciplined (HubSpot experience is a big plus). Have a reliable computer, fast internet, a quiet space, and a good headset. Bonus points for any exposure to M&A, business brokerage, sales, finance, or real estate. This is probably NOT for you if You want a non-phone, purely admin role (this job is conversations). You're uncomfortable hearing "no" and moving to the next call. You can't work U.S. Mountain Time hours. Why you'll want to stay A clear mission and a team that treats its people like partners. Long-term stability, real ownership of your pipeline, and training in a high value industry. Room to grow as we scale. Strong performers here move up. Paid on time, every time.

estimates, follow-ups due, and next actions WHAT YOU MUST KNOW — NON-NEGOTIABLE Do not apply without real experience in ALL of the following: GoHighLevel (GHL) — pipelines, contact management, notes, tasks, and basic workflow triggers. Experience in outbound calling, telesales, or B2B appointment setting (at least 1 year) Comfortable working independently from a script while still sounding natural Reliable, fast internet and a quiet place to call from Organised — the tracking sheet must be updated same day, every day Responsive on Telegram Nice to have: Experience calling Australian or New Zealand businesses WHAT WE PROVIDE Full calling script for every industry (tested and ready to use) Pre-built lead list with company name, phone, industry, and priority rating 3CX login so your calls show as a local Auckland number A 30-minute onboarding call before you start Call recordings reviewed together in the first week so you get real feedback HOW TO APPLY We read every application, but we only respond to people who follow these instructions: Record a 60-second voice introduction. Answer this question in writing: Describe a time you had to get past a receptionist or gatekeeper to reach a decision-maker. What did you say? What happened? Tell us your current timezone and confirm 6:00am–9:30am Philippines time works for you Monday to Thursday. We're looking for someone who takes pride in their communication and wants a stable, long-term role — not just a one-off project. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

If there is a clog or line issue, we may be able to help during the same visit instead of the customer needing to call another company, pay another fee, and wait another day. What We Are Looking For Required Experience • 3+ years phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, or BPO experience. • Experience speaking with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or U.K. customers. • Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines. • CRM experience preferred; Jobber experience is a plus. • Home services, plumbing, HVAC, pest control, roofing, garage door, or similar service company experience is a strong plus. No accent or light accent required. • You must be easy for U.S. callers to understand over the phone. • You must be able to understand customers without repeatedly asking them to repeat themselves. • You must be able to explain pricing and service benefits naturally, not just read a script. Skills and Qualities • Warm, patient, and confident phone manner. • Comfortable asking for the booking when the customer is ready. • Detail-oriented and accurate with names, addresses, phone numbers, prices, and scheduling notes. • Able to memorize simple pricing and local service area towns. • Reliable attendance and strong follow-through. • Good judgment when a customer is upset, has an emergency, or needs a technician quickly. • Willing to learn basic septic service language over time. Technical Requirements • Reliable computer suitable for voice calls, CRM work, email , and basic social media tasks. • Stable internet with at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload. • Backup internet connection, such as mobile data or a second ISP. • Quiet workspace for professional customer calls. • Quality headset with noise-canceling microphone. • Ability to use phone/CRM systems, email , text messaging tools, Google Workspace, and basic design tools such as Canva. Information You Will Be Expected to Learn The right candidate does not need septic experience on day one. We will train you. However, you must be able to memorize and use simple information, including: • Basic pump-out pricing, including common tank sizes. • Which towns are in our service area. • How to explain pump-outs, septic backups, hydrojetting, and camera inspections in simple customer-friendly language. • How to identify when a customer is ready to book versus when they need a follow-up. Payment Schedule Paid twice monthly through an agreed payment platform such as Payoneer, Wise, EasyPay, or similar. Growth Opportunity Long-term role with room for rate increases as performance and company growth support it. Contractor Relationship This is an independent contractor role. The contractor will: • Complete IRS Form W-8BEN for U.S. tax purposes. • Handle their own Philippine tax obligations. • Use their own equipment, internet connection, and workspace. • Be paid a flat contracted monthly rate plus any earned bonus. We provide clear expectations, training on our systems, regular feedback, and a stable long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. service company. Screenshot of computer specs. 5. A 2-3 minute video recording using the script below. Required Voice Recording Script Please record yourself saying this naturally. Do not use AI voice tools. We are listening for clarity, confidence, pacing, warmth, and whether U.S. customers will be able to understand you easily over the phone. “Hi, this is [Name] with Open Water Septic. I understand your septic system is backing up. We can help with that. Our standard pump-out for a 1,000-gallon tank is $500. What makes us different is that we bring more than just a pump truck. Our truck also has a hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of the line at up to 3,000 PSI, and we also have a sewer camera that can inspect the line in color up to 150 feet. That means if the problem is more than just a full tank, we may be able to help solve it during the same visit instead of you needing to call another company and wait another day.”

description: #About Us We are a technology-driven real estate investment company buying homes directly from property owners. We are looking for an experienced cold caller who can connect with U.S. homeowners, find motivated sellers, and help book quality appointments for our acquisitions process. This role is for someone who has already called U.S. homeowners before. We are not looking for a general VA or someone who only has customer service experience. Performance Targets After training, we expect consistent daily activity and quality conversations, including: * 300–600 outbound dials per day, depending on dialer setup and list quality * 10–25 real homeowner conversations per day * 3–8 qualified seller leads per week * 1–4 qualified appointments per week * Clean CRM notes and accurate follow-up tasks * Daily end-of-shift reporting We care about real seller conversations and qualified opportunities, not just dialing numbers. ## What We’re Looking For * At least 1 year of U.S. real estate cold calling experience * Experience calling homeowners such as absentee owners, expired listings, FSBOs, probate, pre-foreclosure, tired landlords, or similar lists * Clear, confident spoken English * Comfortable making outbound calls every day * Experience using a dialer and real estate CRM * Strong listening and note-taking skills * Ability to follow a call structure while still sounding conversational * Reliable computer or laptop * Noise-cancelling headset * Stable high-speed internet * Quiet workspace * Availability during U.S. business hours in Eastern Time ## Helpful Experience Experience with any of the following is a plus: * Real estate wholesaling or investor lead generation * GoHighLevel, REsimpli, Podio, Follow Up Boss, Mojo Dialer, BatchDialer, ReadyMode, CallTools, or similar tools * SMS or email follow-up * Appointment setting for real estate acquisitions teams ## Compensation * Starting pay: $4/hour for the first 60 days * After 60 days, pay may increase to $5/hour based on reliability, call quality, CRM accuracy, and performance * After 6 months, pay may increase to $6/hour based on proven performance * $20 bonus per qualified appointment set * $250 bonus per closed deal from a lead you generated * Additional bonuses may be available for consistent appointment setting and strong lead quality ## Please Do Not Apply If * You have never cold called U.S. homeowners * Your only experience is general VA, customer service, or basic appointment setting * You are not comfortable making outbound calls daily * You cannot work during U.S. business hours in Eastern Time * You have no experience using a real estate CRM or dialer * You are not comfortable doing a live cold call role-play during the interview process * You cannot provide voice recordings with your application ## How to Apply Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Voice Recording #2: 1–2 minute introduction covering your background, real estate cold calling experience, motivation, and how you handle rejection. 6. Cold calling performance history: daily call volume, conversations per day, qualified leads per week, appointments set per week, and list types you have called before. 7. Dialers and CRMs you have used. 8. Available working hours in Eastern Time. 9. Minimum hourly rate and target monthly earnings with bonuses. (based on experience) Performance bonuses tied to: Qualified leads generated Closed patients sourced Long-term role with growth potential. and independently * Commercially aware and interested in business growth * Comfortable following a process, but willing to suggest improvements * Interested in technology, cyber security and professional services Required Skills and Experience The ideal candidate will have experience with: * CRM setup, administration or pipeline management * Lead generation and prospect research * B2B business development support * Appointment setting or sales administration * Data entry, list building and CRM hygiene * Cold email or LinkedIn outreach * Follow-up campaigns * Professional written communication * Basic reporting and sales activity tracking * Working remotely and managing tasks independently Highly Regarded Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded: * MSP, IT services or cyber security sales support * Australian B2B markets * Medical, legal, accounting, hospitality or professional services sectors * LinkedIn Sales Navigator * HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Salesforce or similar CRM platforms * Email campaign tools * Apollo, Clay, ZoomInfo, Lusha or similar prospecting tools * Canva or basic marketing support * Proposal follow-up and sales coordination * Building sales processes from scratch What Success Looks Like In this role, success means: * Defy IT has a clean, usable and well-structured CRM * Target industries and prospect lists are properly organised * Leads are categorised, tagged and easy to manage * Follow-ups are not missed * Outreach activity is consistent and measurable * Prospect records include useful research, not just names and phone numbers * Qualified appointments are booked with suitable businesses * Pipeline reports are accurate and easy to understand * Defy IT has a repeatable sales process that can improve over time This role is about building the foundation first, then helping us turn that foundation into real sales opportunities. Defy IT is building a stronger, more security-focused MSP for businesses that need reliable technology support. We are not trying to be the cheapest IT provider. We are focused on clients who value professionalism, security, responsiveness and long-term partnership. The Role We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to make outbound calls to small home-service business owners across the United States. Your one job: get them interested and book a short discovery call with our founder. Working Hours This is a part-time role (~25 hours/week) on a set call schedule in US Central Time (Dallas, TX). Reliable availability during scheduled US CST call blocks is required. TO APPLY — voice recording required (no exceptions) Record ONE audio clip, about 60 seconds, in two parts: Part 1 — read this script exactly as written: "Hi, is this the owner? title: Facebook Lead Generation & Messenger Sales Rep
job_title: Facebook Lead Generation & Messenger Sales Rep
description: We're a licensed Florida moving company, hiring one sharp, self-driven Facebook Messenger sales rep to find people who are moving and book them through chat. We provide the Facebook account and all the tools. You bring great English, strong sales instincts, and the hustle to go find the opportunities yourself. ?? Read this first: this is a hunting role, not a script-reading role. We give you the Facebook account, the quote tool, and the payment system. We do NOT hand you a list of groups or a pile of leads. Finding the right Facebook groups, spotting the right people, and figuring out what actually works is up to you. We'll support you and share what we learn together, but we're looking for someone who takes ownership and figures things out, not someone who needs to be told exactly where to look. The better you get at finding opportunities, the more you earn. What you'll do every day: 1) Find and join the right local Facebook groups yourself. Part of the job is discovering where people who are moving actually hang out 2) Spot the right people and signals (just bought a house, relocating, need movers, selling furniture) and start warm, natural Messenger conversations 3) Ask a few quick questions and enter them into our quote tool. It builds the price for you, you don't calculate anything 4) Present the quote and send a secure deposit link to book the job 5) Follow up politely until they book or say no 6) Log your conversations in a simple sheet You're a great fit if you are: 1) A resourceful self-starter who takes initiative and doesn't need hand-holding 2) Excellent at natural, written English (you'll message US customers all day) 3) Experienced in sales, chat support, or appointment-setting 4) Comfortable using Facebook & Messenger and confident finding your way around groups 5) Fast to reply, organized, with stable internet 6) Available for Sunday - Friday, 7PM-10PM EST (Monday - Saturday, 7AM - 10AM GMT+8) You do NOT need: your own Facebook account (we provide it), design skills, or any ad experience. This is a long-term role, we want someone to grow with us. HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is a sales role, so following instructions is the first test): 1) Start your message with the word BIGBOYS at the very top. Applications without it will not be read. 2) In 2–3 sentences, tell me about your best sales or chat-support experience. 3) Rate your written English 1–10 and tell me where you learned it. 4) If we gave you the Facebook account today with no list of groups, how would you go about finding the right groups and the right people who are moving? (A few sentences. This is the most important question.) 5) Then answer this: Someone posts in a local group, "Just closed on our new house in Tampa, anyone recommend a good mover?" Write (a) the public comment you'd leave and (b) the first private message you'd send them. I read every application that starts with BIGBOYS and answers #4 and #5.

title: VA Sales Specialist Fitness
description: JOB TITLE: Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant — Inbound Closer + B2B Hunter for Premium Fitness Studios (Base + Uncapped Commission) JOB OVERVIEW: We are a premium fitness company operating TWO studio locations in California, anchored by expert personal training and complemented by boxing, yoga, strength training, and calisthenics. We are hiring a Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant to be our dedicated closer across BOTH locations — owning every lead from first touch to signed membership, AND proactively building a B2B pipeline for corporate wellness and group programs. This is a high-leverage role: two studios, two lead pools, two markets — and uncapped commission across all of it. If you are a hunter who loves the phone, the close, and the commission check, keep reading. If you are looking for a "sit back and reply to email s" job, this is NOT for you. ------------------------------------------------------------ WORKING HOURS ------------------------------------------------------------ Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time (US). This is non-negotiable — it covers our peak lead and member-acquisition window across both locations. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION — BASE + UNCAPPED COMMISSION ------------------------------------------------------------ BASE SALARY: USD $600 per month, paid bi-monthly via Wise or Payoneer. COMMISSION STRUCTURE — PERCENTAGE-BASED, UNCAPPED: TIER A — PERSONAL TRAINING PACKAGES (our flagship service) 8% of the total contract value of every PT package you close. Examples: - 3-month PT package at $1,800 sold:    $144 commission - 6-month PT package at $3,600 sold:    $288 commission - 12-month PT package at $7,200 sold:   $576 commission - Premium custom PT ($10,000+):         $800+ commission TIER B — GROUP STUDIO MEMBERSHIPS (Boxing, Yoga, Strength, Calisthenics) 6% of the first 12 months of contract value on every new membership you close. Examples: - Month-to-month at $179/mo (12 mo value = $2,148):    $129 commission - 6-month commitment at $159/mo ($1,908 value):        $115 commission - 12-month commitment at $139/mo ($1,668 value):       $100 commission TIER C — B2B / CORPORATE WELLNESS — THE BIG MONEY TIER 12% of total contract value on every B2B deal you source AND close. This is corporate wellness packages, team training, group programs for companies, executive PT for C-suite teams, and any business-to-business contract. Examples: - 10-employee corporate wellness package at $8,000:    $960 commission - 25-employee team training program at $20,000:        $2,400 commission - Annual corporate retainer at $36,000:                $4,320 commission We are based in the Bay Area / Silicon Valley — tech companies, startups, and professional firms within 25 miles are all in play. The B2B pipeline is wide open. Whoever builds it wins. TIER D — PIPELINE-BUILDING BONUSES (paid even before the close) - $5 per fully qualified inbound opportunity added to the pipeline (BANT-qualified: budget confirmed, decision-maker reached, timeline established, fit confirmed). - $25 per booked B2B discovery call (verified decision-maker, company size 25+ employees, scheduled on a real calendar). - $100 milestone bonus when you source, qualify, AND close a B2B deal entirely on your own outreach. TIER E — MONTHLY VOLUME BONUSES (stack on top of all commission above) - 10+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$100 bonus - 20+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$300 bonus - 30+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$800 bonus TIER F — MULTI-LOCATION BONUS - $100 monthly bonus when KPIs are hit across BOTH studio locations. REALISTIC EARNING POTENTIAL: With two studios feeding the pipeline and B2B in play, a strong closer can realistically earn USD $2,000–$4,500 in commission per month ON TOP of base. Top performers who land 1–2 B2B deals per quarter can exceed USD $5,000/month in total compensation. Uncapped. Period. PAYMENT TERMS: - Base paid on the 1st and 15th. - Commission paid the month following the close, after the customer's first payment clears. - Pipeline bonuses paid monthly with base. - 14-day clawback window if a sale is refunded. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU WILL DO ------------------------------------------------------------ INBOUND SALES (across both locations) - Respond to every inbound lead within 5 minutes during your shift — SMS, email , DM, phone. - Qualify leads using our discovery framework. - Book or close — your call based on the lead's heat. - Run discovery calls, present the right package, handle objections, close the sale. - Send agreements via DocuSign and follow up until signed and paid. NURTURE & RECOVERY - Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 manual follow-up sequence on every unconverted lead. - Re-engage cold leads from the last 12 months. - Win back churned members from the last 6 months. B2B OUTBOUND PIPELINE-BUILDING (high-leverage) - Build a target list of 100+ Bay Area companies (25–500 employees) within 10 miles of our locations. - Cold outreach via LinkedIn, email , and phone to HR leaders, People Ops, and Founders. - Pitch corporate wellness, team training, executive PT, and group programs. - Book discovery calls on the owners' calendar. - Own the deal cycle from first touch to signed contract. CRM HYGIENE & REPORTING - Real-time pipeline updates across both locations. - Weekly sales report every Friday: leads, calls, consults, deals closed, commission earned, B2B pipeline status. ------------------------------------------------------------ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS ------------------------------------------------------------ ENGLISH: - Fluent, near-native spoken and written English. - NEUTRAL ACCENT REQUIRED — must sound clear and professional to American customers, including corporate decision-makers. Your audio sample (see "How to Apply") is the first thing we review. SALES EXPERIENCE: - Minimum 2 years of phone-based sales experience. - Strong preference for: fitness sales, gy ---------- mberships, personal training sales, wellness, beauty, med spa, real estate, insurance, or high-ticket B2C closing. - B2B experience is a major plus. - Proven track record hitting quota — be ready to share specific numbers. PERSONALITY: - Friendly. People should feel like you actually care, because you do. - Dynamic. High-energy, naturally enthusiastic, the kind of voice that makes someone smile through the phone. - Resilient. Rejection sharpens you, not breaks you. - Hungry. You want the commission and you'll do the work to earn it. - Coachable. Feedback is fuel. TECHNICAL: - Comfortable on Zoom, Google Meet, MindBody / GHL / similar CRM, DocuSign, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Slack. - Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps). - Quiet workspace, zero background noise during calls. - Working webcam, professional-grade headset (not laptop speakers, not earbuds). - Modern computer running smoothly. PREFERRED (BONUS — NOT REQUIRED): - Personal experience as a gy ---------- mber, PT client, or fitness enthusiast. - Familiarity with the US fitness market and Bay Area / California consumer mindset. - Prior B2B prospecting or cold outreach experience. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO WILL HATE THIS JOB ------------------------------------------------------------ - People afraid of the phone. - People who hate cold outreach. - People who don't want their performance measured in numbers. - People who think 12–8 PM Pacific is "too late" (3 AM – 11 AM Manila — yes, schedule shift required). - People who want a flat hourly rate with no upside. - People who think "sales" is a dirty word. If those bullets felt seen — please do not apply. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY ------------------------------------------------------------ To prove you actually read this entire job description, your application MUST include ALL of the following. Applications missing ANY item will be rejected without review. 1) START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THIS EXACT PHRASE on the very first line: "PRECISION-CLOSED-2026" 2) ANSWER THIS QUESTION in 3–5 sentences (placed deep in the post on purpose): "What is your favorite response to the objection 'I need to think about it' — and why does it work?" 3) ANSWER THIS B2B QUESTION in 3–5 sentences: "If you had to land your first corporate wellness deal in 30 days, what would your first three outreach moves be?" 4) BRIEF INTRODUCTION (3–5 sentences): Why you, why sales, why fitness. 5) SALES TRACK RECORD: List your last 2 sales roles with these specifics: - Company / industry - Product or service sold - Average ticket size in USD - Your monthly quota and your average attainment % - Top commission month you ever earned (in USD) - Any B2B closing experience (yes/no, and details if yes) 6) AUDIO SAMPLE: A 60-second voice recording (MP3, M4A, or Vocaroo link) where you read this script in your natural sales voice: "Hi, this is [Your Name] calling from Bellcore Fitness in Santa Clara. I'm following up on your inquiry about our personal training program. I'd love to learn a little about your goals and see if we'd be a good fit. Do you have a quick two minutes right now?" 7) VIDEO INTRODUCTION: A 60-second unscripted Loom or video selfie, on camera, with good lighting. send to ---------- 8) EXPECTED MONTHLY BASE SALARY in USD. 9) EARLIEST POSSIBLE START DATE. 10) INTERNET SPEED TEST SCREENSHOT from ---------- or speedtest.net. 11) CONFIRMATION you can work the 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time shift Monday through Friday. ------------------------------------------------------------ HIRING PROCESS ------------------------------------------------------------ - Week 1: We review every complete application. title: Virtual Car Rental Sales Representative
description: Virtual Sales Representative — Carzi (Car Rental) Location: Remote (supporting Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport operation) Type: Part-time or Full-time Hours of operation: Sunday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Arizona time) Schedule: Shifts assigned weekly — flexibility required About This Role This is a sales job first and foremost. If you live for the close, get a rush from hitting targets, and treat every customer inquiry as a chance to sell — keep reading. If you’re looking for a passive customer-service seat where you answer questions and wait for your shift to end, this isn’t it. Carzi is an independent car rental company at Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport with a fleet of ~100 vehicles and a contactless rental model. Our customers book online and handle everything by text and phone — they never stand at a counter. That means you are the salesperson and the storefront. Every text is a selling opportunity. Every call is a chance to upsell. The reps who win here are the ones who treat this like commissioned sales, not a help desk. What You’ll Actually Be Doing (Selling) • Close rentals. Turn inquiries, quotes, and “just checking prices” texts into booked, paid reservations. You own the conversion. • Upsell on every booking. Vehicle upgrades, damage protection, prepaid fuel, add-ons — you’ll have penetration targets on each, and we’ll track them. Top performers move the numbers; we notice. • Win back the fence-sitters. Follow up on abandoned bookings and lukewarm leads and bring them across the line. • Sell over text and voice. Build rapport, create urgency, handle objections, and close — all without ever meeting the customer face to face. This is a craft, and we want people who are good at it. • Process payments, deposits, and payment requests accurately • Run risk-based checks on reservations — review customer and payment details, flag high-risk bookings, and apply verification policies to protect against fraud and chargebacks • Keep reservation records clean and well-documented What We’re Looking For • A real sales background. Inside sales, retail sales, call-center sales, car rental upselling, or any role where you carried a quota and hit it. Tell us your numbers. • A genuine desire to sell. You see “no” as “not yet” and you actually enjoy turning a maybe into a yes. • Proven closer over text and phone — you can build rapport and close without face-to-face contact. • Comfortable juggling multiple software systems at once (rental management, SMS, payment tools — TSD or similar a plus) without dropping the sale • Strong judgment for risk — you can spot a sketchy booking and know when to verify, escalate, or decline • Excellent, fast, persuasive written communication — most of your selling happens over text • Self-managed and reliable in a remote environment • Available within operating hours (Sun–Fri, 6 AM–10 PM AZ time) with flexibility on weekly shift assignments Big Pluses • Documented sales performance — upsell/ancillary penetration rates, conversion rates, quota attainment, leaderboard finishes • Car rental experience (virtual or counter — reservations, sales, or operations) • Experience with contactless or remote rental operations Compensation • Part-time and full-time positions available • Shifts within Sunday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM Arizona time, set weekly • Competitive base with upside for performers — this is a role where selling well pays off How to Apply Don’t just send a résumé — sell us on you. Tell us about your sales experience and, specifically, a time you closed a tough sale or turned a hesitant customer into a paying one. Include real numbers if you have them (conversion rate, upsell penetration, quota %). Show us you can sell, starting with this message.

title: Local B2B Advertising Sales Representative
description: ABOUT SUMMER HOUSE MEDIA CO. Summer House Media Co. is an emerging media company focused on creating local advertising opportunities that help small businesses increase visibility in the communities they serve. Our current offer is a shared direct mail advertising campaign. Local businesses can reserve ad space on a professionally designed 9 x 12 postcard that is mailed to approximately 5,000 households in a targeted local area. We are seeking a sales professional who can manage the full sales process and support campaign coordination from initial outreach through advertiser onboarding, proof approval, and mailer completion. ABOUT THE ROLE The Local Advertising Sales Representative will manage the full end-to-end sales cycle and advertiser coordination process for Summer House Media Co.’s Shared Local Mailer program. This is not an appointment-setting-only role. The selected contractor will be responsible for moving qualified prospects from initial research and outreach through follow-up, objection handling, closing, payment coordination, advertiser intake, proof approval follow-up, and campaign completion. PRIMARY GOAL The primary goal is to help fill available paid advertising placements for a monthly shared local mailer while ensuring confirmed advertisers submit the materials and approvals needed to move the postcard into print. A confirmed paid placement means that a business has selected an advertising tier, submitted payment, and that payment has been received and confirmed. WHAT YOU WILL BE SELLING The Shared Local Mailer is a professionally designed 9 x 12 postcard mailed to approximately 5,000 local households in selected ZIP codes or carrier routes. Businesses can choose from three advertising placement tiers. Premium Anchor Ads are priced at $650. Standard Feature Ads are priced at $475. Starter Local Ads are priced at $325. Quarterly visibility packages may also be available for businesses that want to appear in multiple consecutive mailings and maintain category visibility over time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Research and source qualified local businesses within assigned target areas and priority business categories. Build, organize, and maintain a clean prospect list and sales pipeline. Conduct cold calls, email outreach, and approved follow-up communication with local business owners and decision-makers. Qualify prospects by identifying decision authority, current marketing needs, service area, promotional opportunities, and fit for the mailer. Present the Shared Local Mailer offer clearly, professionally, and accurately. Explain placement options, campaign timeline, local household reach, and the value of category visibility. Follow up consistently with warm leads and und ---------- prospects through the campaign reservation deadline. Handle common objections related to cost, timing, current marketing efforts, direct mail, and return on investment. Help businesses choose between one-time and quarterly placement options. Ask for the sale and move interested businesses toward a clear decision. Send or coordinate payment links and follow up until advertiser payment is received. Document all outreach activity, prospect notes, follow-up dates, sales status, objections, and outcomes in the assigned lead tracker. Send advertiser intake forms after payment is confirmed. Collect and organize advertiser materials, including logos, business details, contact information, promotional offers, website links, QR code destinations, photos, and brand preferences when available. Follow up with advertisers who have incomplete or missing materials before campaign deadlines. Track advertiser materials, intake completion, placement details, proof status, and approval status. Coordinate advertiser proof review and collect written approval before final print production. Follow up with advertisers regarding proof edits, missing approvals, or final corrections. Maintain organized campaign folders and advertiser records. Help coordinate final advertiser details for print preparation and mailing. Notify advertisers when the mailer has been sent or is scheduled to mail. Begin renewal conversations with advertisers after the campaign is mailed and identify potential quarterly package opportunities. Provide feedback on lead quality, messaging, objection patterns, high-performing categories, advertiser issues, and opportunities to improve future campaigns. IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is confident in outbound sales and comfortable speaking with small business owners and decision-makers. You should be comfortable owning both top-of-funnel outreach and end-of-funnel conversion, along with basic campaign coordination responsibilities after the sale. This means you can research prospects, start conversations, build trust, follow up, handle objections, ask for the sale, coordinate payment, collect advertiser materials, manage deadlines, track approvals, and keep the campaign moving forward without requiring constant supervision. You should be organized, self-directed, professional, consistent with follow-up, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a deadline-driven environment. Experience in cold calling, business development, local business sales, advertising sales, marketing services, client acquisition, lead generation, account management, sales support, project coordination, or service-based sales is strongly preferred. Experience selling print media, direct mail, shared mailers, local promotions, agency services, or advertising is helpful but not required. CAMPAIGN EXPECTATIONS The selected contractor will be expected to consistently source and contact qualified local businesses, build and manage a pipeline of interested prospects, follow up with warm leads, help secure paid ad placements, collect advertiser materials, track approvals, and maintain organized campaign records throughout the cycle. Lead sourcing will be shared. Summer House Media Co. will provide target market direction, priority business categories, sales materials, campaign details, and strategic lead guidance. The sales representative will be expected to source and build the majority of the prospect list and outreach opportunities. COMMUNICATION AND REPORTING EXPECTATIONS The selected contractor will provide every-other-day progress updates during active outreach. A weekly summary report will also be required. Weekly reports should include outreach activity, prospect pipeline status, warm leads, paid placements, advertiser intake status, missing materials, proof approvals, common objections, high-performing categories, follow-up priorities, and recommended next steps. The assigned lead tracker and campaign tracker must be updated consistently throughout the campaign. Major campaign issues, strong sales opportunities, late-stage prospects, missing advertiser materials, late proof approvals, or risks to the sales or production timeline should be communicated promptly. WHAT WE PROVIDE Summer House Media Co. will provide a campaign overview, sales timeline, sales flyer, one-page offer sheet, pricing and placement information, sales script, cold email templates, lead tracker format, campaign tracker format, target business categories, market direction, payment process, advertiser intake process, proofing workflow, automated tools and campaign support. COMPENSATION This is a performance-aligned contract. Compensation details will be discussed with selected candidates. The pilot structure may include a limited hourly component, commission on confirmed paid advertiser placements, and performance bonuses tied to campaign outcomes. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Success is not measured only by calls made, email s sent, or meetings booked. Success is measured by consistent prospecting, strong follow-up, organized pipeline management, professional communication, movement of qualified prospects through the full sales cycle, confirmed paid advertising placements, timely advertiser intake, complete materials collection, proof approvals, and a well-organized campaign ready for print. HOW TO APPLY Please include a brief summary of your outbound sales, business development, client coordination, or campaign support experience. Please describe your experience cold calling small businesses, local business owners, or decision-makers. Please share any experience selling advertising, marketing services, local promotions, print media, direct mail, agency services, or service-based offers. Please include your availability. Please provide a brief example of a campaign where you helped generate leads, appointments, closed sales, collected client materials, coordinated approvals, or supported campaign delivery. Please share your preferred compensation structure for project-based sales and campaign coordination work. We are looking for a sales professional who can combine consistent outbound activity with thoughtful follow-up, strong organization, advertiser coordination, and a results-focused approach to closing paid placements and helping deliver the campaign.

description: # Client Relationship & Business Development Manager ## CRT Australia (Remote – Philippines) ### Full-Time | Work From Home ### Salary: AUD $1,500 per Month + Performance Commissions --- ## About CRT Australia CRT Australia is a growing Australian disability and community services organisation providing support services to NDIS participants across Australia. Our mission is to help people live more independently, achieve their goals, and access high-quality support services that improve their quality of life. We have an extensive database (340 clients ) of previous participants and families who have received services in the past. Many of these clients are no longer actively engaged, creating a significant opportunity to rebuild relationships and reconnect them with services that may benefit them today. --- ## About The Role We are seeking an exceptional Client Relationship & Business Development Manager to become a key member of our team. This is not a cold-calling role. This role will commence in 7-14 days. You will be contacting previous participants, families, carers and referral sources who already know our organisation. Your role is to rebuild relationships, identify current needs and help reconnect people with the supports and services they require. You will be responsible for approximately 340 inactive clients and will play a major role in helping grow the organisation. --- ## Key Responsibilities ### Client Relationship Management * Contact previous participants and families. * Build genuine long-term relationships. * Conduct regular follow-up calls. * Maintain accurate CRM records. * Improve client retention and engagement. ### Business Development * Re-engage inactive participants. * Identify opportunities for additional supports. * Generate referrals and new opportunities. * Assist participants through onboarding processes. * Build relationships with Support Coordinators, Plan Managers and families. ### Sales & Growth * Convert inactive clients back into active participants. * Increase utilisation of participant funding. * Identify opportunities across: * Social Supports * Community Access * Allied Health ( Physio, OT, Speech) * Domestic Assistance * Lawn & Garden Maintenance * Housing and Support Services --- ## What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days: * Contact 100% of inactive clients. * Complete CRM notes for all conversations. * Generate at least 30 meaningful participant conversations. * Successfully re-engage former participants. * Create a pipeline of new business opportunities. * Increase overall participant utilisation. --- ## Essential Requirements ### Must Have * Excellent spoken and written English. * Outstanding communication skills. * Previous sales, customer service or relationship management experience. * Ability to build rapport quickly. * Strong organisational skills. * Reliable internet connection and home office setup. * Ability to work independently and manage your own workload. ### Highly Desirable * Previous NDIS experience. * Healthcare experience. * Allied Health experience. * Disability sector experience. * Community services experience. * CRM experience. * Appointment setting experience. * Business development experience. --- ## The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who: * Loves talking to people. * Builds trust quickly. * Is highly empathetic. * Is motivated by helping others. * Is confident asking for business. * Enjoys solving problems. * Wants to be part of a growing Australian organisation. This role is ideal for someone with a healthcare, disability, aged care or allied health background who also enjoys sales and business development. --- ## Salary & Incentives ### Base Salary AUD $1,500 per month + commissions Salary will be based on experience, NDIS knowledge and previous performance. ### Performance Commissions Additional commissions paid for: * Re-engaged participants. * New participant referrals. * New service commencements. * Revenue growth achieved. High performers will have significant earning potential through the commission structure. --- ## Career Opportunity This is not just a sales role. The successful applicant will have the opportunity to grow into a senior client relationship, operations or business development position as CRT Australia continues to expand. W want this role to be a long term role where you will continue to manage those relationships of those particpants who you can successful re engage with. the role will involve a 2 weeks trial period of access to previous 30-40 clients and results will speak for themselves. --- ## To Apply Please provide: 1. Your resume. 2. A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and answering the screening question below 3. Details of any NDIS, healthcare or Australian business experience. 4. Details of your previous sales achievements. 5. An example of a difficult client relationship that you successfully rebuilt. ### Screening Question You are calling a participant who has not used our services for 18 months. What would you say during the first 60 seconds of the call to rebuild rapport, create trust and start a meaningful conversation?

title: Outbound Calling Sales Person/Onboarding Manager
description: I am the founder of an online marketplace platform that is similar to airbnb, except it's specifically designed for long-term-care facilities for the elderly and disabled. We serve Adult Family Homes, Assisted Living Facilities and Nursing Homes. When one of these homes has an empty room available for an elderly person, they can list it on our website with photos and pricing info. When a family needs to find care for an elderly parent, they can go on our site and search their city to see all the available rooms nearby. They can contact the business with any questions, schedule a tour, request a quote or book the room. We're looking for a friendly, patient and self motivated outbound caller with outstanding sales and English speaking skills. The ideal candidate is a very committed person seeking steady and long-term employment in a position that will help thousands of elderly people and small business owners. This position is full time. Job Description: You will be cold-calling assisted living businesses to offer to list their available rooms on our website/platform for free - so that families can find them easier. 90% of the time, the people you will be speaking with are the business owners themselves. (The other 10% will be their employees.) Most facilities accept Medicaid clients. (Medicaid is a social service for low-income individuals. The government pays the cost of their care, but at a much lower price than private-pay) Business owners will have the option to post their Medicaid openings for free, or if they are looking for private pay clients, they can post their private pay openings on a monthly subscription (optional). If they agree to sign up and list their room(s), you will start by creating an account for them. You will ask their name, email and phone number. After you create an account for them, you'll then attach them as a user to their Organization profile. The next step is to ask them specific questions about their facility as you fill out their facility details such as Contact info, amenities, alcohol, tobacco, pets policies, equipment, and what they do or don't do at their facility. You'll then create two listings for them over the phone. One free Medicaid listing, and one Private Pay listing. The Medicaid listing will be published and live right away, but the private pay listing will stay unpublished. You'll ask them certain questions about about the room they have available, and about the services they offer, and what type of client they are looking for. You'll check all the boxes with their answers. You'll then ask them to get on our website either from their computer or phone, and you'll ask them to search their city from our homepage, and see how their listing looks. You will explain exactly how the entire process works, and instruct them where to click and exactly what to do. You'll explain how the free Medicaid listings work, and how the paid Private Pay subscriptions work. We have a very specific word-for-word script that you'll follow until you have the script and process memorized. Once you end the call, you'll send them a welcome email with additional instructions. The email will have instructions for setting a password, updating any of the facility information, adding photos, and starting a private pay subscription. They can either add photos themselves or email you their photos, and you'll need to add them to their listings. You will update a spreadsheet with all the businesses you sign up every day. You will remain their point of contact in case they need any help on their account. When we call businesses this way, we sign up 1.5 - 2 new accounts/listings per hour, and you will have no problem doing the same within just the first few weeks. The difference between this position and a typical cold-calling sales/telemarketing position is that the majority of the businesses you will be calling are actually happy to hear from you and are excited that you will help them. They have a hard time filling their empty rooms, and there is no service quite like ours. There are no angry people yelling at us or hanging up the phone. Please note that the majority of business owners you call are not native English speakers. Most are immigrants from other countries, and may have limited English and limited experience with computers/internet/technology. This role requires absolute patience. These people have huge hearts for caring for elderly and disabled people, but require some patience with technology. They are usually very self-aware and will tell you they are not good at computers, and they're extremely grateful for our absolute patience in showing them how it all works and explaining in a way that they understand. Pay: The pay is $1,000 month for full time 8 hours per day - plus commissions. While we are ok with the providers creating only free Medicaid listings, we definitely want them to list their private pay listings for the $199/monthly subscription. The $199/month gets them Google Ads, so they will get real google leads to see their listings and contact them directly to book their room. Most of their $199/month goes directly toward Google Ads. Your commission on every single paid subscription is $10. Most clients do not pay for a subscription on-the-spot over the phone, but instead they subscribe in the weeks following your phone call. If a business that you called and signed up pays for a subscription within 3 months of your phone call, you will earn the $10 commission. Every month that they stay subscribed, you will keep getting the $10 commission. Once they find a client and fill their room, they can unsubscribe and remove their ad. If another room becomes available later, and they subscribe again to advertise their opening, you will get the same $10 commission again every month - as long as they re-subscribe within 7 months of ending their first subscriptions. These businesses get an opening every 3-4 months. The average time it takes for them fill a room is 4-6 months. Payday is twice a month around the 1st and the 16th using Payoneer. Trial Period: After the initial training period, you'll start the calls at your own pace on your own. We need to see some of your accounts start signing up for the paid subscriptions as you get more confident and improve. There's a learning curve and the script can be difficult to memorize at first, but overall we'll monitor your sign ups and subscriptions over 2 - 3 months after training. We will know in the first few weeks if you are struggling badly, and will support you with as much additional training as needed. We are patient and willing to spend extra time with you as long as we're seeing improvements. If it looks like you're struggling with no noticeable improvement, or are far below the average with sign-ups, we may end your employment. This has never happened with anyone, but still worth mentioning. Training: I will be training you personally along with our sales director William. He is also Filipino, and has been working with us for over 2 years. We can get on video calls with you as you listen to my calls or William's calls, and watch our screen for the entire calls. You can ask any and all questions in between calls. We'll also send you hours of screen-recorded samples of successful calls to watch and memorize. You can access our Test website and create practice accounts to get used to the software navigation. We will be hiring 3 people for this role, and you'll have the ability to practice doing mock calls with each other to get comfortable with the script. It is a fairly long script because it goes from signing them up, updating their facility info, listing their rooms, to you leading an interactive website demo that they follow along as you explain to them how it all works. It will require some practice, memorization and patience to get comfortable. If you apply for this position, please mention "the assisted living marketplace". Once you're comfortable, you can start calling people as we listen in and watch your screen. If you prefer to record your calls, instead of having us monitor live, that works too. Then you will continue on your own with periodic check-ins from William or myself. Any questions you ever have, you can text or email myself or William. Requirements: Eagerness to memorize the script and process, honesty, patience and communication. We want you to do well and we will continue to train you as long as needed for you to succeed. If you're struggling with anything, please don't be shy or embarrassed or try to hide it. We want to help! We can only succeed if you're succeeding. I've failed more than anyone, and nobody is going to judge you or be mean to you. Outstanding English speaking skills and genuine friendly personality. Our approach is very different from typical cold call sales positions and we will train you until you're a master. Fast reliable Internet, computer and a smart-phone is required. We will provide access to virtual phone numbers through QUO app that you can call/text from. We will also set you up with a company email that you can email from and give to your customers in case they need any further assistance from you with their account. Benefit/PTO You will get 13th month pay in December. In the first year, it the bonus will be relative to the number of months you worked in that first year. You will get 15 days PTO that you choose. You can only take PTO days after 90 days of working unless pre-approved during interview process. There will be 7 additional US holidays that will be paid including Christmas, New Years Day, Thanksgiving, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Memorial Day. Time Zone: Our company is near Seattle, WA USA and the Time Zone is Pacific Time. The calling/working hours are between 8am - 5pm Pacific time. This is a full time position for 8 hrs per day. You can choose which 8 hrs to work as long as it's Mon - Fri within 8am - 5pm Pacific. If you wish to apply for this position, please provide an English voice sample with your application saying the following lines: "Hi, I was calling to see if you guys have a room available?" "Perfect! I work with families, with hospitals, and with Medicaid to help you get clients without agencies or referral fees. We have a website where we list Adult Family Homes that have current openings. Would you be against me adding your availability to our site?" If you have any questions or if there's anything I missed, please let me know. Thank you! Vitaly

title: Medical Sales Representative - Cold Calling
description: About Us We’re building a global talent pool of high-performing remote Medical Sales Representatives (Cold Callers) to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative, and allied health support. Role Overview As a Sales Representative (Cold Calling), you’ll be the first voice many people hear. You’ll contact warm and/or cold leads, introduce clinic services, handle basic objections, and book qualified appointments or drive next steps (e.g., intake form completion, discovery call scheduling). This is a pooling / talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to clinic openings based on: • Your sales experience (healthcare preferred but not required) • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US) • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialers/SMS/email) • Compensation alignment and performance expectations Important: This is healthcare-related outreach. We prioritize professionalism, consent-based communication, and privacy-safe handling of lead data. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) • Make outbound calls to leads (cold, warm, or reactivation lists, depending on clinic assignment). • Qualify prospects using a script and criteria (needs, location, readiness, eligibility, where applicable). • Clearly explain services and next steps in simple, human language (no hype, no pressure). • Book appointments or schedule a consult, and ensure the lead receives confirmations and instructions. • Follow up via SMS/email/CRM to reduce no-shows and improve conversion. • Handle objections professionally (price, hesitation, timing, trust) and escalate clinical questions appropriately. • Keep CRM records accurate: call outcomes, notes, tags, follow-up tasks, and dispositions. • Hit activity and outcome targets (calls/day, connects, qualified appointments, show rate). • Coordinate with patient support/ops teams for smooth handoffs and accurate scheduling. • Maintain compliance: respect do-not-contact rules (if provided), consent preferences, and confidentiality. • Participate in coaching, script optimization, and performance reviews. Must-Have Qualifications • 2+ years experience in cold calling / outbound sales/appointment setting (B2C or B2B). • Strong spoken and written English with confident phone presence. • Comfortable following scripts while sounding natural and empathetic. • Resilient mindset: can handle rejection and stay consistent day-to-day. • Organized and metrics-driven (can work toward targets and track progress). • Strong attention to detail for CRM updates and follow-up scheduling accuracy. • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and clear async communication. • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and backup plan. • Willingness to work shifts overlapping AU/UK/US/NZ depending on assignment. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points) • Experience selling or booking for healthcare, telehealth, wellness, or subscription services. • Experience with consultative selling (needs-based approach vs hard selling). • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zoho) and dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, Dialpad). • SMS/email follow-up experience (Twilio, Podium, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.). • Strong objection handling and ability to improve scripts through feedback. • Experience with compliance-minded outreach (opt-outs, consent language, data privacy). Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples) • CRM: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, GoHighLevel • Dialer/VoIP: RingCentral, Dialpad, Aircall, CloudTalk • SMS/Email: Podium, Twilio, Gmail/Outlook • Productivity: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion/Trello/Asana • Reporting: Google Sheets Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based) • Location: Philippines (remote) • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift) • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening) • US-friendly (PH night shift) • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clean handoffs. Compensation (General Guidance) • Starts at USD 10/hour • Many clinic assignments include performance incentives, such as: • bonus per qualified appointment booked • bonus per attended appointment (show rate) • monthly performance bonus for hitting targets Details vary by clinic and will be confirmed during matching. How to Apply (Required) Please submit: 1. CV / Resume 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering: • Your cold calling/sales background (industry + results) • Your best achievement (e.g., appointments booked/week, conversion rate, revenue) • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialer/SMS/email) • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US) • A short example of how you handle a tough objection politely Important: Applications missing the required CV + video may not be considered. Our Screening Process (What to Expect) • Initial screen (English + sales experience + remote readiness) • Practical task: short role-play + CRM note sample + follow-up message draft • Structured interview: scenarios on objection handling, ethics, and performance consistency Join the Pool If you’re persuasive without being pushy, love the rhythm of outbound calls, and want to help more people access care, we’d love to hear from you.

This person owns everything from the top of the funnel — awareness and lead capture — to the handoff of sales-ready leads to our sales representatives. You will design and execute a multi-channel lead generation strategy including referral partner development, paid digital advertising, organic/SEO content, email marketing, and social media. You will also build the systems and automations that ensure no lead falls through the cracks and every prospect receives timely, consistent follow-up. This is a high-impact, high-accountability role. Sales are the lifeblood of CP Restoration Services and you will be directly responsible for the revenue pipeline. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Referral Partner Development • Identify, recruit, and manage referral partnerships with mortgage brokers, real estate agents, auto dealerships (F&I managers), CPAs, tax preparers, financial advisors, and apartment leasing offices. • Build co-branded marketing materials and custom landing pages for each referral partner. • Implement a referral tracking system (PartnerStack or equivalent) so partners can monitor their referrals and commissions in real time. • Set monthly referral volume targets and maintain relationships through regular check-ins. 2. Paid Digital Advertising • Plan, launch, and manage Facebook and Instagram lead generation ad campaigns targeting individuals with credit challenges. • Manage Google Search Ads campaigns targeting high-intent keywords such as “credit repair near me” and “remove collections from credit report.” • Explore YouTube and TikTok ad opportunities to build brand awareness and generate inbound leads at lower cost. • Monitor cost-per-lead, cost-per-acquisition, and ROAS across all paid channels and optimize weekly. • Manage the ad budget efficiently and report performance to ownership monthly. 3. We invest in our people and we pay well because we expect a lot. You will be working directly with our founder and leadership team. This is not a traditional sales role. You will not be cold calling or doing outbound prospecting. Prospective clients have already expressed interest in our services before speaking with you. Your job is to walk them through what we do, assess whether they are a good fit, and connect qualified prospects with our Lash Growth Specialist for the next step. Alongside that, you will be managing relationships with our existing clients — answering their questions, reviewing their performance reports on Zoom, handling their concerns, and most importantly, overcoming objections from clients who are frustrated or uncertain. This part of the role requires emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to stay calm and professional when a client is upset. Schedule Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (MST) 30-minute unpaid lunch break Two 15-minute breaks per day You must be fully available and online during all working hours. Please verify the MST time zone against your local time before applying. Late starts, early finishes, and unexplained absences will not be tolerated. What You Will Be Doing Discovery Calls Get on Zoom calls with prospective clients who have reached out to learn about Swoop Lift Introduce yourself and explain our services clearly and confidently Assess whether the prospect is a qualified fit for our program Book a follow-up call with our Lash Growth Specialist for qualified prospects Handle any objections the prospect raises calmly and professionally Client Success Management Respond promptly and professionally to existing client questions via WhatsApp and other channels Get on Zoom calls with clients to review their monthly performance reports Handle client concerns and complaints with empathy and composure Overcome objections from clients who are frustrated, uncertain, or pushing back Escalate serious concerns to management through the proper internal process Keep accurate notes and records on every client interaction Requirements English — This Is Non-Negotiable This role requires a level of English proficiency that is indistinguishable from a native speaker in both spoken and written form. Our clients are North American small business owners. Any accent, grammatical error, or awkward phrasing that makes a client feel they are speaking to someone overseas will damage the client relationship and reflect poorly on Swoop Lift. You must speak English fluently and clearly with no accent that would be noticeable or distracting to a North American client. You will be on Zoom calls every single day with your camera on. You must write in flawless English — correct grammar, correct spelling, correct punctuation, and natural phrasing — at a fast typing speed. All client communication is written and must be professional and error-free. You must be able to produce all written communication yourself without the use of AI writing tools. We test for this during the hiring process and throughout employment. Use of AI to write client-facing messages is grounds for immediate termination. You must be a fast typist. If your typing speed is below 50 words per minute, this role is not for you. Other Requirements You must be comfortable on camera. Every call is conducted on Zoom with your camera on. This is not optional. You must have a reliable internet connection, a quiet working environment, and a clean professional background for video calls. You must have strong emotional intelligence. Our clients are small business owners who are often stressed and reactive. You need to stay calm, composed, and empathetic when a client is difficult without taking it personally. You must have excellent common sense and the ability to make decisions independently. We cannot micromanage every client interaction. You will need to read situations, use good judgment, and handle things on your own without being told what to do. You must be organized and detail-oriented. You will be managing multiple client relationships simultaneously. You must be a fast learner. We will train you on our services and processes but you are expected to retain information and apply it independently. What We Are Not Looking For Candidates who need to be told what to do in every situation Candidates who use AI to write their responses and pass it off as their own work Candidates who struggle under pressure or become flustered when clients are difficult Candidates who are not fully available during the required working hours Candidates whose spoken or written English requires any effort for a North American to understand If any of the above describes you, please do not apply.
