We cover our clients' ad spend, manage their leads, and book appointments on their behalf — all for a flat weekly fee. We are a fast-growing, results-driven company that holds itself to a high standard. Every person on our team has a direct impact on client outcomes and company growth. We invest in our people and we pay well because we expect a lot. About This Role This is a full-time remote position that combines two functions: inbound discovery sales and client success management. You will be working directly with our founder and leadership team. This is not a traditional sales role. You will not be cold calling or doing outbound prospecting. Prospective clients have already expressed interest in our services before speaking with you. Your job is to walk them through what we do, assess whether they are a good fit, and connect qualified prospects with our Lash Growth Specialist for the next step. Alongside that, you will be managing relationships with our existing clients — answering their questions, reviewing their performance reports on Zoom, handling their concerns, and most importantly, overcoming objections from clients who are frustrated or uncertain. This part of the role requires emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to stay calm and professional when a client is upset. Schedule Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (MST) 30-minute unpaid lunch break Two 15-minute breaks per day You must be fully available and online during all working hours. Please verify the MST time zone against your local time before applying. Late starts, early finishes, and unexplained absences will not be tolerated. What You Will Be Doing Discovery Calls Get on Zoom calls with prospective clients who have reached out to learn about Swoop Lift Introduce yourself and explain our services clearly and confidently Assess whether the prospect is a qualified fit for our program Book a follow-up call with our Lash Growth Specialist for qualified prospects Handle any objections the prospect raises calmly and professionally Client Success Management Respond promptly and professionally to existing client questions via WhatsApp and other channels Get on Zoom calls with clients to review their monthly performance reports Handle client concerns and complaints with empathy and composure Overcome objections from clients who are frustrated, uncertain, or pushing back Escalate serious concerns to management through the proper internal process Keep accurate notes and records on every client interaction Requirements English — This Is Non-Negotiable This role requires a level of English proficiency that is indistinguishable from a native speaker in both spoken and written form. Our clients are North American small business owners. Any accent, grammatical error, or awkward phrasing that makes a client feel they are speaking to someone overseas will damage the client relationship and reflect poorly on Swoop Lift. You must speak English fluently and clearly with no accent that would be noticeable or distracting to a North American client. You will be on Zoom calls every single day with your camera on. You must write in flawless English — correct grammar, correct spelling, correct punctuation, and natural phrasing — at a fast typing speed. All client communication is written and must be professional and error-free. You must be able to produce all written communication yourself without the use of AI writing tools. We test for this during the hiring process and throughout employment. Use of AI to write client-facing messages is grounds for immediate termination. You must be a fast typist. If your typing speed is below 50 words per minute, this role is not for you. Other Requirements You must be comfortable on camera. Every call is conducted on Zoom with your camera on. This is not optional. You must have a reliable internet connection, a quiet working environment, and a clean professional background for video calls. You must have strong emotional intelligence. Our clients are small business owners who are often stressed and reactive. You need to stay calm, composed, and empathetic when a client is difficult without taking it personally. You must have excellent common sense and the ability to make decisions independently. We cannot micromanage every client interaction. You will need to read situations, use good judgment, and handle things on your own without being told what to do. You must be organized and detail-oriented. You will be managing multiple client relationships simultaneously. You must be a fast learner. We will train you on our services and processes but you are expected to retain information and apply it independently. What We Are Not Looking For Candidates who need to be told what to do in every situation Candidates who use AI to write their responses and pass it off as their own work Candidates who struggle under pressure or become flustered when clients are difficult Candidates who are not fully available during the required working hours Candidates whose spoken or written English requires any effort for a North American to understand If any of the above describes you, please do not apply. Compensation Base Salary: 86,412.13 PHP per month Sign-On Bonus: 5,000 PHP upon successful completion of probation Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based, available after probation — details discussed during the interview Employment Type: Full-time, remote How to Apply We do not accept applications through this platform alone. To be considered you must complete both of the following steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed. Step 1 — Download Telegram and send your resume to: ---------- Step 2 — Record a video of yourself responding to the following objection as if you are speaking to a real client on a Zoom call: "I love what you guys do and it sounds amazing but honestly I just cannot afford it right now. It is too much money for me at this stage." Video requirements: Camera must be on. We need to see your face. State the current date clearly at the beginning of the video. Videos without the date will not be accepted. Length should be between 2 and 4 minutes. Speak naturally. Do not read from a script. Audio must be clear and your background must be clean and professional. Send the video to the same Telegram number along with your resume. The video is your first impression. Treat it like the interview has already started. Only candidates who impress us in the video will be contacted for the next stage.

description: NOVA Signage is a leading provider of custom signage manufacturing solutions for sign shops, print shops, distributors, and trade buyers across North America. Our website serves as a B2B member login portal where we offer custom signage products, wholesale partner pricing, quote support, and production services designed to help our clients sell more signage products without expanding their own manufacturing capacity. We are looking for a reliable B2B Outbound Caller / Lead Qualification Specialist to join our team. This is a remote, part-time position based in the Philippines, starting at 20 hours/week, with the potential to increase hours based on performance. The cold callers should know how to professionally navigate gatekeepers, identify decision-makers, collect accurate details, and make meaningful business-to-business calls. This is not a hard-selling role. Your main responsibility is to call sign shops and printing shops in North America, identify the right contact person, collect accurate information, and confirm whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit. Our internal sales team will handle qualified leads and follow-up conversations. Responsibilities Call sign shops, print shops, and commercial signage companies in North America. Identify the right decision maker, such as owner, general manager, production manager, estimator, purchasing manager, or operations manager. Confirm whether the company is a good fit for NOVA’s wholesale/custom signage manufacturing services. Collect accurate contact information, including contact name, role, email address, phone number, company website, and shipping address. Ask qualified prospects whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit. Record call results clearly and accurately in our CRM, Google Sheet, or lead tracking system. Follow a simple calling script and qualification process. Handle gatekeepers professionally and politely. Update lead status after every call, such as wrong number, not qualified, decision maker found, email collected, sample kit approved, follow-up needed, or not interested. Escalate interested prospects to the NOVA sales team for follow-up. Maintain a professional, calm, and friendly tone on all calls. Qualifications 3+ years of experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, or B2B prospecting. Experience calling businesses in the United States or Canada. Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, and professional accent. Strong listening skills and attention to detail. Ability to follow a script without sounding robotic. Comfortable speaking with receptionists, gatekeepers, owners, managers, and purchasing contacts. Able to collect and enter information accurately. Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment. Basic computer skills, including Google Sheets, CRM systems, email , and online phone platforms. Fluent in spoken and written English. Ability to commit to 20 hours per week. Must be available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Pacific Time. Good to Have Experience with B2B appointment setting for U.S. companies. Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or similar platforms. Experience using online phone systems such as OpenPhone, Aircall, JustCall, RingCentral, or similar tools. Experience in signage, printing, construction, manufacturing, wholesale, or B2B services. Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines. Comfortable using call recording, call notes, and lead qualification workflows. What You Are Not Required to Do You do not need to close sales. You do not need to negotiate prices. You do not need to provide technical product advice. You do not need to promise lead times, warranty terms, or pricing. You do not need to run long sales presentations. Your goal is to identify the right person, confirm interest, collect accurate information, and pass qualified leads to our internal sales team. How We Work We offer a highly entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and operational work environment. We prioritize action over discussion, and we value reliability, clear communication, accuracy, and a growth-oriented mindset. Feedback is given openly and regularly to encourage continuous improvement. We value people who are consistent, honest, detail-oriented, and easy to train. This role is measured by call quality, accuracy of information, qualified contacts found, sample kit interest confirmed, and clean daily reporting. Work Schedule Part-time: 20 hours per week 4 hours per day, 5 days per week Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Pacific Time (Tues-Sat 12:00 AM – 4:00 AM Manila Time) This schedule requires working during North American business hours. In the Philippines, this will usually be late night to early morning, depending on daylight saving time. Compensation Part-time: Monthly 32,00–35,000 PHP, depending on experience 20 hours per week Compensation will depend on outbound calling experience, English communication quality, accent clarity, reliability, attention to detail, and performance. Please answer the form: ---------- Important We are looking for someone professional, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable making outbound calls to North American businesses. This is not a high-pressure sales job. We value clear communication, accurate data, polite follow-up, and consistent daily execution.

description: International B2B Sales Agent / Business Development Representative Client Acquisition for Warehouse, Fulfillment & Operational Facility in Poland We are looking for an experienced International B2B Sales Agent / Business Development Representative to help us acquire a foreign client or business partner for our operational facility near Warsaw, Poland. This is not a standard Virtual Assistant role. We are not looking for someone who only sends email s, fills in spreadsheets, or passes us empty leads. We need someone who can actively contact companies, make phone calls, speak with decision-makers, ask the right questions, understand business needs, and deliver qualified opportunities for advanced business discussions. ? About the Project We have an operational facility in Marki, near Warsaw, Poland, which can be used as: * warehouse space, * fulfillment point, * packing / labeling area, * light assembly or simple production space, * local operational base, * distribution support hub for Poland and Central/Eastern Europe, * local partner location for a foreign company entering the Polish / EU market. The facility includes: * approx. 500 m² hall space with staff / social area, * approx. 300 m² covered warehouse shelters, * approx. 2,500 m² yard / land area, * paved and monitored area, * maneuvering yard, * possibility to adapt the cooperation model to the client’s needs, * possibility to organize staff and operational support. We are looking for foreign companies that may need a flexible local partner in Poland / CEE instead of immediately setting up their own company, warehouse, team, and local structure. ? Target Companies We are especially interested in companies that: * do not yet have a strong operational structure in Poland or the EU, * want to enter Poland, Central/Eastern Europe, or the EU market, * have logistics, customs, warehousing, fulfillment, or distribution problems, * need a smaller and more flexible alternative to large 3PL providers, * sell premium, specialized, technical, medical, cosmetic, industrial, or B2B products, * may benefit from local warehousing, fulfillment, labeling, packing, distribution support, operational coordination, or market entry support. Interesting markets include: * United Kingdom, * USA, * Canada, * Australia, * Singapore, * UAE, * India, * Asia, * other non-Polish / non-EU international markets. We do not want to focus only on one country. We are looking for companies for which Poland can solve a real supply chain, distribution, European market entry, or warehousing problem. ? What We Already Have You will not start from zero. We already have: * initial database of potential companies, * target industries and markets, * company email address, * Apollo account for contact verification, * CloudTalk / calling tool, * outreach tracker, * first tested outreach messages, * call script framework, * clear business objective. We need someone who can take this process and turn it into real business conversations. ? Your Main Responsibility Your task is to actively acquire a real business opportunity. You will be expected to: * contact companies by phone, email , and LinkedIn, * identify the right decision-makers, * speak with people responsible for logistics, operations, distribution, expansion, procurement, or partnerships, * understand the company’s current situation, * ask about operational problems, market entry plans, volume, budget level, and decision process, * qualify whether the company is a real fit, * prepare a complete lead profile before handing it over to us. We do not want “empty leads” such as only a company name or generic email address. A qualified opportunity should include: * company name and website, * country and industry, * contact person and position, * confirmation that the person is relevant, * current activity in Europe / Poland / CEE, * current logistics, warehouse, distributor, 3PL, or partner setup, * operational problem or business need, * expected support needed, * possible volume or scale, * possible timeline, * budget level or cost expectations if discussed, * decision-maker information, * recommendation for next step. Only after this information is collected can our team prepare a serious business proposal. ? Requirements We are looking for someone with real experience in: * B2B sales, * cold calling, * international outreach, * appointment setting, * business development, * lead qualification, * speaking with decision-makers, * working toward a concrete business result. You must be comfortable making business phone calls in English. Experience in logistics, warehousing, fulfillment, distribution, export/import, e-commerce, manufacturing, medical devices, industrial products, or market entry will be a strong advantage. ? Compensation This role is based on a low base rate + high success fee model. Trial Period * Trial period: 7–10 days * Trial rate: 3 USD/hour * Goal: verify your ability to make calls, qualify prospects, collect useful business information, and report clearly. Success Fee We are ready to pay a strong success fee for real results. Success fee starts from 2,000 USD and may be higher, depending on: * the type of client, * the value of the cooperation, * whether the client starts with a small pilot or larger operation, * whether the client uses part of the facility or the full location, * expected monthly cooperation value, * long-term potential of the relationship. The success fee is paid for a real business result — a company genuinely acquired through your work that enters into actual cooperation with us. This is a strong opportunity for someone who trusts their B2B sales skills and wants to earn mainly from results, not only from hours. ? Long-Term Opportunity If the acquired company d ---------- to cooperate with us, this does not have to be the end of your role. You may continue as our: * international communication coordinator, * account manager, * business development representative, * foreign partner communication representative. Your role could include maintaining communication with the foreign partner and supporting the ongoing cooperation. ? Important We have limited time to secure a foreign partner for this location. If we do not find the right foreign company, the facility may be rented to a local Polish business. In that case, this international sales role may no longer be needed in the same scope. We need someone who can take this seriously, act quickly, and focus on real client acquisition. ? How to Apply Please answer the questions below in your application: 1. What is your experience in B2B sales and cold calling? 2. Have you acquired foreign clients by phone before? 3. What industries have you worked with? 4. Do you have experience with logistics, warehousing, fulfillment, distribution, export/import, e-commerce, manufacturing, or market entry? 5. How many business phone calls can you realistically make per day? 6. How do you qualify a cold prospect before handing it over to a client? 7. How do you ask about needs, budget, volume, timeline, and decision-maker? 8. What sales tools have you used? 9. How many hours per week can you realistically dedicate to this project? 10. Are you comfortable with a 3 USD/hour trial period and a high success fee for real results? 11. What success fee would you expect for a genuinely acquired client? 12. Write a short example of a first email to a UK or US company that may need a flexible operational base in Poland. 13. Write a short first-call script for such a company. Generic applications without answers to these questions will not be considered. We are looking for someone who can say: “Give me the database, tools, and clear goal, and I will call, find the right people, qualify the opportunity, collect the information, and move the company toward serious business conversations.” If this describes you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Business Research Interviewer
description: Hey! I'm looking for someone to help me with the second stage of a business research project. The goal is simple: talk to business owners and uncover how they actually work. This isn't a sales role. You won't be selling anything or trying to convince anyone to buy a product. Instead, you'll be conducting qualitative research through customer interviews. You'll receive a research brief containing: • A clearly defined niche. • A clearly defined Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). • A summary of how businesses in that niche typically operate. • Existing solutions and competitors. • A clearly reasoned operational problem that you believe is worth validating. Your job is to validate or challenge that hypothesis by speaking directly with business owners. Your responsibilities will include: • Reviewing the research brief. • Creating an interview guide. • Contacting businesses by email , LinkedIn and/or phone. • Scheduling interviews. • Conducting approximately 10–20 interviews. • Recording interviews (with permission). • Creating AI transcripts. • Writing a short summary after every interview. • Adapting the interview questions if new themes emerge. At the end of the project, I'd like to receive: • Interview recordings (where permission was given). • Interview transcripts. • A summary for every interview. • The final interview guide. • Any observations that you think will help the analyst understand the interviews. The project pays €300 and is expected to take about three weeks. I'm looking for someone who is naturally curious, listens carefully, and asks good follow-up questions. To apply, please give me a short introduction about yourself. I’d also like to see how you approach this kind of work, so please walk me through your thought process for the following: • Imagine you’re about to interview a business owner. What information would you want to uncover, and why do you think it’s important? • If, halfway through the project, you discover that the original hypothesis seems wrong, what would you do? • Imagine you're interviewing the owner of a small business. They tell you everything is running smoothly. How would you continue the conversation to uncover potential problems? Feel free to give examples of things you would ask/say. This project is expected to begin after the previous stage of the research project has been completed. I'll keep you updated on the expected start date throughout the process. Don't overthink the application or make it sound overly corporate. Just write how you normally would. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Market Research / Lead gen
description: Hey! I'm looking for someone to help me with the first stage of a business research project. The goal is simple: identify one business niche with a recurring operational problem that's genuinely worth investigating. You can choose any industry you want, as long as it meets these criteria: • Businesses already spend money trying to solve the problem. • Decision-makers are easy to reach through LinkedIn or email . • There is a recurring problem tied to time, money, or risk. • The problem is common enough that businesses are already dealing with it somehow. • It isn't in the adult or gambling industry. Your responsibilities will include: • Find one promising business niche that meets the project requirements. • Narrow that niche down to a specific target customer. • Research how businesses in that niche typically operate. • Form a hypothesis about one recurring operational problem worth investigating. • Generate a qualified lead list of 50–70 businesses that match your chosen ICP. By the end of the project, I’d like to receive a PDF handoff document for the interviewer to start their outreach. It should contain: • A clearly defined niche. • A clearly defined Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). • A summary of how businesses in that niche typically operate. • Existing solutions and competitors. • A clearly reasoned operational problem that you believe is worth validating. • A spreadsheet containing the lead list. I'm looking for someone who can think critically, connect different pieces of information, and justify why a particular opportunity is worth investigating. AI is completely fine to use for brainstorming, organizing notes, and speeding up research. Just don't rely on it as evidence. Everything you conclude should be supported by sources you've verified yourself. The project pays €125 and is expected to take about seven days. To apply, please tell me the following: • A short introduction about yourself. • Previous experience, if applicable. • How you would approach this project during the first few days. Don't overthink the application or make it sound overly corporate. Just write how you normally would. Looking forward to hearing from you!
